title: Visitator til Myndighed, Sundhed og Omsorg
description:
Er du vores nye kollega i Myndighed, Sundhed og Omsorg?

Vil du være med til at finde de bedst mulige løsninger for den enkelte borger – og brænder du for at skabe gode resultater gennem stærke samarbejdsrelationer?

Er du sundhedsfagligt uddannet, har erfaring fra pleje- og omsorgsområdet og motiveres du af at gøre en forskel for mennesker i forskellige livssituationer? Trives du i krydsfeltet mellem faglighed, myndighedsudøvelse, dialog og samarbejde? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Vi søger en engageret visitator til vores myndighedsteam.

1 visitatorstilling på fuld tid – tiltrædelse pr. 1. februar 2027, gerne tidligere.

Hos os handler myndighedsarbejde om mennesker, muligheder og samarbejde

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt arbejdsfællesskab med dygtige og engagerede kollegaer, hvor vi vægter åben dialog, faglig sparring, tillid og gode relationer højt. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes, når vi bringer vores forskellige fagligheder og perspektiver i spil og arbejder sammen med respekt for hinandens opgaver og kompetencer.

Vi har et stort ønske om at være en god og konstruktiv samarbejdspartner – både for borgerne og deres pårørende og for de mange medarbejdere, ledere, fagpersoner og samarbejdspartnere, vi møder på tværs af organisationen og sektorerne. Vi er nysgerrige på andres perspektiver, lytter til deres viden og erfaringer og tager ansvar for, at samarbejdet bidrager til sammenhængende og meningsfulde løsninger for borgerne.

I vores team er vi alle sundhedsfagligt uddannede med en solid baggrund fra klinikken og praksisfeltet, og vi har derudover en visitatoruddannelse i rygsækken. Det giver os et stærkt fagligt fundament og en fælles forståelse for den virkelighed, som både borgere og medarbejdere står i.

Vi arbejder ud fra en rehabiliterende og helhedsorienteret tilgang, hvor vi tager udgangspunkt i det enkelte menneskes livssituation, ønsker, ressourcer og behov. Vi er optagede af at finde løsninger, der giver mening for borgeren, understøtter selvbestemmelse og selvhjulpenhed og skaber de bedste muligheder for et godt og meningsfuldt hverdagsliv.

Samtidig er vi en myndighed, og det ansvar tager vi alvorligt. Vores opgave er at foretage faglige, konkrete og individuelle vurderinger og træffe afgørelser inden for den gældende lovgivning og de politisk fastsatte serviceniveauer. Vi skal kunne balancere borgerens ønsker og behov med de rammer og muligheder, vi som kommune har til rådighed. Det kræver både faglig sikkerhed, ordentlighed, tydelig kommunikation og evnen til at finde gode løsninger – også når der skal forventningsafstemmes.

Vi er midt i en spændende udvikling

Ældrereformen har sat en ny retning for ældreplejen, og vi er sammen med resten af organisationen godt i gang med at omsætte de nye intentioner til praksis.

Det betyder nye muligheder og nye måder at tænke hjælp, omsorg og støtte på.

Vi er optagede af at udvikle vores myndighedspraksis, så den understøtter mere fleksible, borgernære og sammenhængende løsninger, hvor rehabilitering, selvbestemmelse og tillid er centrale omdrejningspunkter.

Vi ønsker at være en myndighed, der ikke alene administrerer og træffer afgørelser, men som aktivt bidrager til udviklingen af området og til at skabe de bedst mulige rammer for borgernes liv og hverdag.

Som visitator får du derfor en vigtig rolle – både i mødet med den enkelte borger og i samarbejdet om at udvikle fremtidens kommunale omsorgs- og plejeområde.

Dine opgaver

Som visitator er din vigtigste opgave at sikre, at borgerne får den rette hjælp og støtte på baggrund af en konkret og individuel vurdering af deres samlede situation. Du skal kunne se muligheder, tænke helhedsorienteret og inddrage borgerens egne ressourcer og ønsker – samtidig med at du arbejder inden for de gældende lovgivningsmæssige og politisk fastsatte rammer.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

Udredning og behovsvurdering:Gennem dialog med borgeren og eventuelt pårørende afdækker du borgerens funktionsevne, ressourcer, ønsker og behov. Du har blik for hele mennesket og den sammenhæng, borgeren indgår i.

Sagsbehandling og visitation:Du træffer fagligt funderede, konkrete og individuelle afgørelser om blandt andet personlig og praktisk hjælp, madordning, pleje og omsorgsforløb, midlertidige ophold, aflastning, dagcenter, pleje- og ældreboliger, HandyBAT, omsorgstandpleje m.m. med afsæt i gældende lovgivning og kommunens politisk fastsatte serviceniveau. Vi arbejder primært efter serviceloven, ældreloven og sundhedsloven.

Borgerinddragelse, rehabilitering og samskabelseDu er optaget af at finde løsninger sammen med borgeren, der understøtter selvbestemmelse, mestring og størst mulig selvstændighed. Du ser borgerens egne ressourcer og netværk som vigtige elementer i den samlede indsats.

Koordination og samarbejdeDu bidrager aktivt til at skabe sammenhæng i borgerens forløb gennem et tæt og tillidsfuldt samarbejde med hjemmeplejen, terapeuter, sygeplejen, hospitaler, andre myndighedsområder og øvrige relevante samarbejdspartnere. Du er med til at bygge bro mellem forskellige perspektiver og fagligheder med borgerens bedste for øje.

Kommunikation og forventningsafstemningDu kommunikerer tydeligt, respektfuldt og ordentligt – også når borgerens ønsker og forventninger ikke kan imødekommes. Du kan formidle de faglige vurderinger, afgørelser og rammer, der ligger til grund for vores beslutninger, så borgeren oplever sig lyttet til og mødt med forståelse, også når svaret ikke bliver det ønskede.

Faglig udviklingDu bidrager aktivt til udviklingen af vores myndighedspraksis og er nysgerrig på, hvordan vi hele tiden kan blive bedre. Du deler din viden, udfordrer vante arbejdsgange og er med til at omsætte nye politiske og faglige intentioner til en god praksis for borgerne.

Hvem er du?

Vi søger en kollega, der:

  • Har en mellemlang videregående sundhedsfaglig uddannelse, f.eks. som sygeplejerske, ergoterapeut eller fysioterapeut, og gerne erfaring fra primær pleje- og omsorgsområdet.

  • Har interesse for myndighedsarbejde og gerne erfaring med myndigheds- og forvaltningsopgaver.

  • Brænder for at finde gode og meningsfulde løsninger for den enkelte borger og kan se muligheder inden for de givne rammer.

  • Er en stærk samarbejdspartner, der prioriterer relationer, dialog og gensidig respekt – både når det gælder borgere, pårørende og professionelle samarbejdspartnere.

  • Er nysgerrig på andres perspektiver og kan bygge bro mellem forskellige fagligheder og interesser.

  • Har en god faglig dømmekraft og kan balancere individuelle behov og ønsker med lovgivning og politisk fastsatte serviceniveauer.

  • Kender sig selv og egne kompetencer godt, og som kan stå sikkert i myndighedsrollen og kommunikere tydeligt og ordentligt – også når der skal gives afslag eller forventningsafstemmes.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret, bevarer overblikket og trives i en hverdag, hvor opgaver og prioriteringer hurtigt kan ændre sig.

  • Bidrager aktivt til et godt arbejdsfællesskab og ser værdien i faglig sparring, videndeling og fælles udvikling.

  • Er en dygtig kommunikator både mundtligt og skriftligt.

  • Har kørekort til bil.

  • Har eller har lyst til at tage visitatoruddannelsen.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et stærkt og engageret arbejdsfællesskab med dygtige kollegaer, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, deler viden og prioriterer faglig sparring højt.

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor samarbejde, ordentlighed, tillid og gode relationer er vigtige værdier.

  • En grundig oplæringsplan, der tager højde for opgavernes kompleksitet og understøtter din faglige udvikling.

  • Mulighed for selvstændigt at tilrettelægge din arbejdsdag og dine opgaver i samarbejde med teamet.

  • En engageret og støttende ledelse, der prioriterer åben kommunikation, løbende sparring og frihed under ansvar.

  • Mulighed for at få indflydelse på udviklingen af myndighedsområdet i en tid, hvor der sker store forandringer på ældreområdet.

  • En hverdag med faglige udfordringer, variation og mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel for borgerne.

Vi leder efter dig, der både motiveres af at se andre lykkes og har fagligheden til at stå sikkert i myndighedsrollen. Dig, der tror på, at de bedste løsninger opstår i mødet mellem borgerens perspektiv, den faglige viden og det gode samarbejde – og som har lyst til at være med til at gøre Myndighed, Sundhed og Omsorg til en endnu bedre samarbejdspartner for alle omkring borgerne.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst og efter principperne i lokal løndannelse.

Der vil blive indhentet straffeattest ved ansættelse.Kørekort til kategori B - Almindelig bil er et krav.

Stillingen er på 37 timer pr. uge.

BRK er en unik kommunal arbejdsplads, fordi øen er en selvstændig region. title: Mechanical Project Engineer - FEM/FEA
description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.  As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too. About the job Ready to take on challenging mechanical engineering work with a clear purpose? With us you will contribute to global priorities such as energy efficiency, clean water, and Alfa Laval's net-zero 2030 ambition. Let's shape a better tomorrow together!  We design and supply process solutions within various industries, mainly water treatment. As a Mechanical Engineer and FEM/FEA specialist, you will design solutions in 3D with detailed engineering combined with standard components. Our designs contain pipes, pumps, decanters, evaporators, membranes, heat exchangers etc.  Your work involves verification and optimization of mechanical and process equipment, by identifying critical stress concentrations, deformations, and failure modes etc. In this role, you will perform simulations as well as traditional hand calculations to ensure our products meet functional, safety, and regulatory requirements. During project execution you will be working in global project teams with Project Managers, Process Specialists, Automation, Sourcing, and Workshops.  Key tasks and responsibilities:     Design steel structures, skid solutions and custom designs in Autodesk Inventor     FEM/FEA analysis on mechanical designs using ANSYS/Nastran including: Static structural, Buckling, Hydrostatic and internal  pressure, Vibrations and fatigue, Thermal and Pipe support.     Hand calculations     Prepare clear technical reports and design recommendations     Review boundary conditions and results from simulations made by others     Optimize calculation methods, templates, engineering standards, and best practices     DFM in collaboration with workshop and FAT/SAT     Review 3D designs and 2D drawings     Ensure compliance with Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 and CE marking     Apply relevant standards like ASCE/SEI 7-22 and EN1993-1-1  Planned travels, mostly within Europe, for inspections and commissioning is part of the job - approximately 20 - 25 days per year. You will be part of an innovative mechanical team of ten who are continuously implementing smarter ways of working. You report to Jesper Bergstrøm, a people-oriented leader who is passionate about his team thriving in their roles and look forward to going to work. At Alfa Laval, we embrace a hybrid work model, allowing you to work from home when it aligns with your tasks.   Who are you You are a results-driven, high-energy professional who maintains focus and a positive attitude while pursuing ambitious goals. You take initiative, make calculated decisions with confidence, and consistently turn plans into action. You build strong networks across and beyond the organization, using your relational skills to influence, collaborate, and create impact. Proactive, timely, and quality-minded, you work effectively with others and help drive collective success.  What you know We are looking for you with solid skills and experience in FEM/FEA analysis with skid- and steel structures solutions. The role involves a lot of collaboration and while you can independently, we believe you enjoy collaborating across disciplines and are able to communicate complex technical topics clearly.  Requirements:     Degree in Mechanical Engineering     Deep knowledge in FEM/FEA analysis with skid- and steel structures solutions.     Working proficiency in defining the scope, building an efficient model, performing the analysis, interpreting the results, and delivering clear engineering conclusions within a typical timeframe of 1-2 weeks depending on complexity.     Excellent communication skills in English   For more information, please contact Jesper Bergstrøm, Engineering Manager, Mechanical Engineering & Design, WIFH PM&E +45 4271 8160 Charlotta Lundblad, Talent Acquisition Partner   We are conducting a continuous review of received applications and the ad might be closed before ending date. We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Please send your application no later than November 25, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long! At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in Søborg (Denmark) or have an established presence in the area.  Our commitment to integrity We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioural traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.  #LI-CL1

title: Rustfri Smed
description:
Rustfri smed

 

Er du erfaren indenfor rustfri svejsning ? Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at være udlært smed – det vigtigste er, at du har praktisk erfaring og kan levere et godt stykke håndværk, og er en kompetent og alsidig håndværker, som har fokus på kvalitet. Vil du gerne indgå som et ansvarligt medlem af et team i en professionelt ledet virksomhed? Så er du måske én af vores nye medarbejdere.

 

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet bestå af:

  • Svejsning og bearbejdning af emner i rustfrit stål

  • Arbejde ud fra tegninger og arbejdsbeskrivelser

  • Kontrol af kvaliteten på de færdige emner

  • Samarbejde med kolleger om at få opgaverne sikkert og effektivt gennem produktionen

Har du også erfaring med aluminium, er det en fordel – men det er ikke et krav.

 

IQ Metal er i vækst, og for at møde vores kunders forventninger om leveringsfleksibilitet og -sikkerhed, har vi besluttet at øge antallet af medarbejdere og investere i en række nye maskiner. Du vil blive en del af et team med mere end 450 medarbejdere i IQ Metal, som samarbejder med store kunder i hele Europa. Vi leverer typisk samlede løsninger af produkter og fokuserer på at give kunderne den bedste oplevelse ved at sikre komplet levering til tiden, i rette kvalitet.

Kan du se dig selv i virksomheden?

Du indgår som en fast del af et godt team med 10-15 mand, som selv planlægger hverdagen og skaber overblik over ordreplanen. Vores maskinpark sikrer, at alt kører som det skal. En del af vores maskiner er fuldautomatiske, mens andre er semi-automatiske. Vi inviterer gerne på en kop kaffe og tur rundt i produktionen, hvis du er interesseret i et job hos os.

Vi tilbyder:

Løn og ansættelsesforhold er gode og konkurrencedygtige, og indeholder udover pension også en sundhedssikring. Alle fastansatte på nathold tilbydes årligt sundhedstjek. Der er kaffe og vand tilgængeligt i kantinen, og vi har en god stemning på virksomheden, som er professionelt ledet.

Kan du se dig selv i jobbet?

Vi tilbyder selvstændigt arbejde i moderne faciliteter. Det er et krav, at du er en erfaren smed, som har arbejdet inden for faget inden for de sidste par år. Du skal have tegningsforståelse, samt selv kunne udvikle og fremstille fiksturer og værktøjer til at sikre optimal håndtering af emner.

Vi forventer at du er en god kollega, som hjælper til når det er krævet af hensyn til teamet og opfyldelse af kunders forventninger. Du har humor og smil på læben i hverdagen, også når der er travlt. Bopæl nær Hasselager/Århus vil være en fordel, men ikke nødvendigvis et krav.

Interesseret?

Læs mere om virksomheden hjemmesiden www.iqmetal.com eller kontakt vores produktionsleder Lars Holm på telefon 8738 9036 for en uforpligtende og fuldt fortrolig snak. Ansøg ved at sende dit CV eller skriv lidt om din erfaring på: lh@iqmetal.com.

title: Postdoc and Assistant Professor Positions in Communications, Radar Systems, and Antenna Design
description:
Would you like to advance wireless connectivity and radar sensing for intelligent devices and autonomous systems? The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one or more Postdoc (2 years) and/or Assistant Professor positions in Communications, Signal Processing, Radar Systems, and Antenna Design. Join a growing research environment connecting electronic systems research with applications in robotics, drones, defence technology, and the Internet of Things (IoT). The preferred starting date is February 1, 2027.

 

Job Content

Your research will advance communications, signal processing, radar systems, and antenna design, with a focus on real-time wireless connectivity, physical-layer technologies, and antennas for intelligent devices, IoT systems, and edge computers. The scope spans 5G, mmWave, terahertz technologies, 6G and beyond, LoRa, software-defined radio, and integrated sensing, including communication protocols, modulation techniques, and antenna design and implementation. Applications include autonomous collaborative robotics, drone swarm communications, radar-based object detection and tracking, low-power radio sensor networks, and defence technology.

You will have the opportunity to connect your research with the section’s complementary expertise in FPGA and neuromorphic computing, edge AI, machine learning, sensing technologies, and energy harvesting. Working with academic colleagues and professional staff across SDU campuses, you will contribute to a collaborative research community and the development of academic programmes.

Postdoc: You will conduct research within the position’s scope, contribute to course planning, support teaching, and supervise Bachelor’s and Master’s students in relevant fields. You will also support the research team in developing applications for external funding.

Assistant Professor: You will develop and sustain a research agenda that strengthens or complements the section’s activities, secure external research funding, and publish in reputable journals and international conference proceedings. You will plan and teach Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses in communications, radar and sensor technologies, and antenna theory and practice, while advising and mentoring students and supervising their research projects. You will also contribute to academic service at section and department levels, participate in professional activities and conferences locally, nationally, and internationally, and undertake other duties assigned by the Section Chair.

 

Required Qualifications

Applicants must hold a PhD degree in Electronics, Communications, or a closely related field. Your application must document the following qualifications:

  • Research expertise relevant to the position in communications, signal processing, or antenna design.

  • Demonstrated potential to teach Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses at university level.

  • For Assistant Professor applicants, pedagogical and subject-specific skills appropriate to the position’s teaching and research responsibilities.

International research experience gained in an environment other than the institution where the applicant completed their PhD will be considered an advantage. 

 

Workplace description 

The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics brings together research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communications. Using advanced reconfigurable computing and sensing technologies, we develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions for autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grids, and healthcare. This breadth creates opportunities to connect fundamental research with practical engineering challenges. 

Our research is organized into four complementary areas: 1) Infrastructure Inspection and Maintenance, 2) Bio-inspired Intelligent Systems, 3) High-Frequency Power Management, and 4) Radar Remote Sensing. The section is growing steadily and comprises 15 staff members, including professors, PhD students, and engineers, who contribute to research, industrial collaboration, and education. We play a central role in electrical engineering education in Odense, contributing to Bachelor’s and Master of Science programmes in Electronics Engineering. 

SDU’s Odense campus brings together six faculties, with a large university hospital soon to join the campus environment, creating opportunities for interdisciplinary research and a vibrant student life. Odense offers a culturally rich setting with a growing robotics community, attractive residential areas, and green spaces along the river through the city centre. 

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU.

 

Further information 

To learn more about the positions and research environment, please contact Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, Head of the Section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics, at esme@sdu.dk. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

We welcome applications outlining how your expertise and research ambitions would contribute to the section. Please submit your application in English and include the following documents: 

  • A motivation letter describing your interest in the position, relevant qualifications, and reasons for joining the section (maximum 2 pages).

  • A detailed curriculum vitae, including contact information, research experience, teaching experience, computational skills, and other relevant qualifications.

  • For Assistant Professor applicants: a Teaching Portfolio documenting your teaching qualifications and experience. 

  • For Assistant Professor applicants: a research plan outlining your proposed research direction and plans for developing a research line, securing external funding, and building a research team. 

  • For Postdoc applicants: a brief research plan outlining your proposed research focus, approach, and expected contributions during the two-year appointment, including its alignment with the position and the section’s activities. 

  • PhD, Master’s and     Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent (original     and an official English translation). 

  • A list of publications, with the most relevant     publications highlighted.  

  • Publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Names and email addresses of up to three     researchers who can provide an informed reference at short notice.     Reference letters and documentation of other relevant qualifications may     also be included.  

  • A statement/documentation     of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

 

The application deadline is December 10, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

The appointments are temporary for an initial 2-year period (for the postdoc position) or 3-year period (for the assistant professor position). Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme.  

Employment as a postdoctoral fellow and assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for either postdoc or assistant professor as described therein.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Produktionslederassistent søges til fast aftenhold i Give
description:
Har du erfaring fra produktion, og trives du med at tage ansvar, skabe overblik og sikre, at hverdagen fungerer? Så har vi en spændende mulighed for dig som produktionslederassistent på aftenhold i Give.

Vi søger en engageret og ansvarsbevidst produktionslederassistent (PLA) til en moderne fødevarevirksomhed i Give, som er i rivende vækst. Her får du en alsidig stilling, hvor du både bliver en aktiv del af den daglige produktion og samtidig får en vigtig rolle i at sikre struktur, samarbejde og en stabil drift på produktionslinjen.

Stillingen er oplagt til dig, der allerede har erfaring fra produktionsmiljøet og gerne vil tage næste skridt i din karriere. Måske har du tidligere haft en koordinerende rolle eller fungeret som mellemleder, eller måske er du den kollega, der naturligt tager initiativ og hjælper med at holde styr på opgaverne, når der er travlt.

Du bliver en del af en virksomhed, hvor der er fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet og godt samarbejde, og hvor du får mulighed for at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt.

Om jobbet:

Som produktionslederassistent får du en vigtig funktion i den daglige drift på aftenholdet. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med dine kolleger i produktionen, hvor du både deltager i de praktiske arbejdsopgaver og hjælper med at koordinere arbejdet, så produktionslinjen kører effektivt.

En stor del af din hverdag vil foregå i produktionen, hvor du blandt andet skal betjene og overvåge produktionsmaskiner samt sikre, at arbejdet bliver udført i overensstemmelse med virksomhedens krav til kvalitet, hygiejne og orden.

Samtidig bliver du en vigtig støtte for dine kolleger. Du skal være med til at skabe overblik over dagens opgaver, hjælpe med at fordele arbejdet og tage initiativ, hvis der opstår udfordringer undervejs. Det kræver, at du kan bevare roen, træffe beslutninger og være med til at sikre en god arbejdsrytme på holdet.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver:

  • Deltagelse i den daglige produktion samt betjening og overvågning af produktionsmaskiner

  • Koordinering af opgaver og understøttelse af en stabil drift på produktionslinjen

  • Opfølgning på kvalitet, hygiejne og orden i produktionen

  • Støtte og vejledning af kolleger i det daglige arbejde

  • Håndtering af udfordringer og sikring af et effektivt produktionsflow

Du får dermed en varieret arbejdsdag, hvor du både kan bruge dine praktiske erfaringer og udvikle dine evner inden for koordinering og ledelse.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring fra produktion og er vant til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor tempo, kvalitet og samarbejde er afgørende for, at opgaverne bliver løst. Har du tidligere arbejdet inden for fødevareproduktion, er det en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og lyst til at tage ansvar.

Du er typen, der naturligt tager initiativ og hjælper til, hvor der er behov for det. Du kan arbejde selvstændigt, men trives også med at være en del af et team, hvor man hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok.

Det er vigtigt, at du er god til at bevare overblikket, også når der er mange opgaver i gang på samme tid. Du arbejder struktureret, er løsningsorienteret og har forståelse for, hvordan man skaber en effektiv hverdag i produktionen.

Har du tidligere haft en rolle som teamleder, produktionskoordinator eller mellemleder, vil det være et stort plus. Det er dog ikke et krav, så længe du har lysten og evnerne til at påtage dig en koordinerende funktion.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra produktion, gerne inden for fødevareindustrien

  • Er ansvarsbevidst, mødestabil og engageret

  • Kan bevare overblikket og træffe beslutninger i en travl hverdag

  • Er samarbejdsorienteret og god til at motivere og hjælpe dine kolleger

  • Trives med både praktiske opgaver og koordinering af personale

  • Taler og skriver dansk

Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig?

Du får mulighed for at blive en del af en moderne fødevarevirksomhed, der er i positiv udvikling, og hvor der er gode muligheder for at vokse med opgaverne.

Her bliver du en del af et produktionsmiljø, hvor du får ansvar og mulighed for at præge den daglige drift. Du får en varieret arbejdsdag med både praktiske og koordinerende opgaver, hvor din indsats har direkte betydning for, at produktionen fungerer optimalt.

Stillingen tilbydes som et Try & Hire-forløb med henblik på efterfølgende fastansættelse. Det giver både dig og virksomheden mulighed for at lære hinanden godt at kende, inden en fast ansættelse.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • Fast aftenhold i en fuldtidsstilling

  • Try & Hire-forløb med mulighed for fastansættelse

  • En spændende rolle med ansvar i den daglige produktion

  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø med fokus på samarbejde

  • En arbejdsplads i rivende vækst

Arbejdstider:

Stillingen er på fast aftenhold.

Arbejdssted: Give

Er du vores nye produktionslederassistent?

Har du erfaring fra produktion, og er du klar til en hverdag, hvor du både får mulighed for at arbejde praktisk og tage mere ansvar? Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send dit CV til mo@teamly.dk, og skriv "PLA" i emnefeltet.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send gerne dit CV allerede i dag.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: DIAS Professor in Clinical Translational Psychiatry and Centre Leader for the Elite Centre for Clinical and Translational Psychiatry at Odense University Hospital and the University of Southern Denmark
description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS), the Department of Clinical Research at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and the Region of Southern Denmark seek an outstanding candidate to fill a fully tenured Professor position in the field of clinical translational psychiatry. The candidate is expected to start by agreement.

The candidate is expected to start by agreement.

We seek an exceptional researcher with demonstrated excellence in their discipline and a proven ability to push boundaries, challenge conventions, and engage in groundbreaking interdisciplinary research. The successful candidate will be expected to contribute to cutting-edge advancements in their field while fostering collaboration across disciplines, embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven research. The ideal candidate will have a strong international research profile, an outstanding record of attracting competitive research funding, and a demonstrated ability to conduct interdisciplinary research. The successful candidate will be attached to the Department of Clinical Research, DIAS, and the Region, and must be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU and in the Region of Southern Denmark. 

What we offer

  • The opportunity to lead a new elite centre for clinical and translational psychiatry, with five-year funding of DKK 17 million (equivalent to Euro 2.3 million), with the potential for a five-year extension.

  • A strong interdisciplinary research environment through DIAS, comprising leading academics across medicine, science, and the humanities, with the opportunity to collaborate with outstanding researchers across SDU’s five faculties.

  • Access to state-of-the-art research facilities at the newly built Odense University Hospital (OUH), where psychiatry and somatic care are integrated to foster collaboration between these fields.

  • Comprehensive research support services from DIAS and SDU, targeting prestigious funding such as DNRF, ERC, and grants from Danish private foundations.

  • If recruited from abroad or from industry, the candidate will be eligible for a fast-track DKK 11 million  (equivalent to Euro 1.5 million ) Lundbeck Foundation Start-Up grant.

  • Reduced teaching obligations compared to a standard professorship, allowing the candidate to focus on research and leadership within the elite centre.

Who we are looking for 

We are seeking a highly accomplished researcher with expertise in the field of clinical translational psychiatry, who is eager to engage in collaborative activities within the DIAS framework. 

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

  • A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

  • A record of internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

  • Publications in high-level peer-reviewed academic journals and leading innovative research programmes in clinical psychiatry. 

  • An ability to attract significant external funding to support independent and collaborative research initiatives.

  • Engagement in the international academic society. 

  • Extensive experience in building and leading multidisciplinary research teams that integrate basic and clinical sciences, with an emphasis on translational research spanning from laboratory findings to clinical trials.

  • A research focus in areas such as child and adolescent psychiatry, clinical psychopharmacology, epidemiology, molecular neurobiology, substance use disorders, or serious mental illness.

  • The ability to develop a translational research programme in one or more of the mentioned fields, with a focus on building cooperative, multidisciplinary teams that bridge basic science and the design and execution of early-phase clinical trials.

  • A demonstrated commitment to mentorship, teaching, and leadership, fostering the next generation of researchers in interdisciplinary research environments.

  • Experience at Full or Associate Professor level within relevant fields.

  • Fluency in English

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, mentor DIAS fellows, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally.  

The Department of Clinical Research

The Department of Clinical Research does translational research spanning from basic research to patient care, within both somatics and psychiatry. The interdisciplinary research aims to improve patient treatment, health, and well-being. Researchers at the institute often have joint appointments between clinic, research, and education, ensuring a strong academic foundation for the research at Odense University Hospital (OUH) and in psychiatry. The researchers at the Department of Clinical Research primarily consist of doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals with main employment at OUH.

The Centre for Clinical and Translational PsychiatryThe centre will be based at the new Odense University Hospital, which integrates psychiatric and somatic care to promote close collaboration between the fields. The hospital includes a state-of-the-art adult psychiatric department with around 600 employees, 142 single rooms, and specialized sections for joint somatic-psychiatric care, rehabilitation, telepsychiatry, and more. The child and adolescent psychiatric department cover the entire region with about 600 employees, two inpatient wards with a total of 34 beds, and outpatient clinics at four geographical sites.The centre’s aim is to advance novel psychiatric research through innovative approaches that will significantly impact future patient care. This includes translating discoveries from the laboratory to clinical settings, whether within narrow clinical fields or through broader cross-disciplinary collaborations that involve various clinical functions, professions, and institutions.

Additional informationFor further information about being a professor at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk For further information and questions about the position, please contact the Head of the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen at +456550 3477 or via email at rllarsen@health.sdu.dk or Medical Director Bjarne Dahler-Eriksen, Odense University Hospital, at +4523284068 or via email at bde@rsyd.dk. You may also contact the Vice Dean for Research and Innovation at the Faculty of Health Sciences, SDU, Uffe Holmskov at +45 6550 3775 or via email at uholmskov@health.sdu.dk regarding the position.

Application, salary, and employment terms

This position will be attached to the Department of Clinical Research in Odense. The successful candidate will be expected to regularly engage in DIAS activities and interdisciplinary cooperation in Odense. 

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

For more details on salary and taxation, please refer to the provided links about salary and taxation.

Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities.

Application requirements

Applications must be submitted electronically via the "Apply now" link provided below.

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

The application must include the following:

  • A motivation letter.

  • A detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV), including contacts for possible references.

  • Copies of relevant certificates/diplomas.

  • A teaching portfolio detailing previous teaching experience.

  • A complete list of publications, highlighting those most relevant to the position.

  • Up to ten of the most relevant publications

  • A research and publication plan for the next five years, including a description of synergy with the department's activities and the potential to benefit from DIAS’s interdisciplinary environment.

All application materials must be submitted in English, and only applications written in English will be considered.

Submission guidelines

  • Files must be submitted in PDF format, with each file no larger than 10 MB.

  • If multiple files are needed for a single section, combine them into one PDF file.

  • Zip files, image files (jpg, png, etc.), and password-protected PDF files will not be accepted. All PDF files must be unlocked to allow binding.

  • The application deadline is February 7, 2027, at 23:59 CET. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

Applications that are incomplete with regards to the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed by the committee. Shortlisting and tests may be used in the recruitment process and references may be obtained.  

We recommend that international applicants take the time to visit the websites of Work in Denmark and the International Staff Office at SDU. Here you will find information and facts about moving to, working, and living in Denmark.

Assessment

Shortlisting may be used as part of the recruitment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material.  

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns themselves.

About SDU

SDU is committed to fostering a diverse staff that reflects society’s diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background.

SDU was founded in 1966 and now has over 27,000 students, nearly 20% of whom are international. SDU employs more than 3,800 staff and offers 115 study programmes across disciplines such as the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, and engineering. While SDU’s main campus is in Odense, it also has campuses in other locations.Equal opportunity employment

The University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. 

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to several security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

title: Tyskunderviser til Køge

title: 2 Assistant Professor Positions (non-tenured) with a Focus on Innovation in Pharmacy or Medicinal Chemistry at SDU in Odense
description:
The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for 2 positions as Assistant Professor with a focus on innovation within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

The positions are expected to commence on 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. Each position is fixed-term for 3 years.

The positions are intended for talented early-career researchers who wish to develop an independent academic profile at the intersection of research, innovation and education. The successful candidates will conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry and contribute to translating scientific knowledge into solutions with potential value for patients, healthcare, society or the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors.

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science and is located at SDU’s main campus in Odense. The department is responsible for educational programmes in chemistry, medicinal chemistry and physics, as well as the bachelor’s programme in pharmacy. The successful candidates will join the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and become part of an interdisciplinary research environment with strong opportunities for collaboration across scientific fields and with external partners.

 

Research and innovation profile

The assistant professors will develop and conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear focus on innovation and application. Relevant research may include, but is not limited to, the discovery, design, development, formulation, delivery, analysis or evaluation of pharmaceutical substances, technologies and products. Innovation is understood broadly and may involve the development or application of new:

  • compounds, drug candidates or therapeutic concepts;

  • formulations, drug-delivery systems or pharmaceutical products;

  • experimental, analytical, computational or data-driven methods;

  • technologies, platforms, processes or research tools;

  • approaches to solving challenges relevant to patients, healthcare, society or industry.

The successful candidates are expected to identify the innovation potential of their research and contribute to its maturation and translation. Depending on the nature and stage of the research, this may include validation of concepts, development of prototypes or proof of concept, collaboration with relevant users and external partners, protection of intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or other pathways to application and impact.

The positions provide an opportunity for early-career researchers to develop an independent research and innovation profile. Applicants are therefore not expected to have an extensive record of patents, commercialization or entrepreneurship. Relevant previous experience is an advantage, but equal emphasis will be placed on the applicant’s scientific qualifications, motivation and potential to develop innovative research.

 

Roles and responsibilities

The assistant professors will be expected to:

  • Establish and develop an independent research programme within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear innovation perspective.

  • Conduct high-quality research and communicate the results through scientific publications, conferences and relevant outreach activities.

  • Identify and explore the scientific, societal and/or commercial potential of research ideas and results.

  • Develop research-based concepts, methods, technologies or solutions towards validation, proof of concept or application, where relevant.

  • Establish collaborations across disciplines and engage with relevant academic and external partners, such as companies, hospitals, healthcare professionals, public authorities, innovation environments or other users.

  • Apply for or contribute to applications for external research and innovation funding.

  • Contribute to teaching and course development within the department’s educational programmes, particularly pharmacy, medicinal chemistry and related areas.

  • Contribute to research-based and innovation-oriented teaching, including the involvement of students in relevant research and innovation activities.

  • Supervise and mentor bachelor’s and master’s students and, where relevant, contribute to the supervision of PhD students and other junior researchers.

  • Participate actively in the academic environment and contribute to the continued development of the department’s research, innovation and educational activities.

  • Participate in public engagement, knowledge exchange and other activities that strengthen the relationship between the university and the surrounding society.

 

The ideal candidate

We seek ambitious and collaborative early-career researchers with:

  • A PhD degree in pharmacy, medicinal chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry or another closely related field.

  • A strong scientific background relevant to research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

  • The ability and motivation to develop an independent research and innovation profile.

  • A clear interest in translating scientific knowledge into new concepts, methods, technologies, products, practices or other solutions.

  • The potential to identify relevant needs and opportunities and engage with academic and external partners.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills and an interest in interdisciplinary research.

  • Proficiency in spoken and written English.

 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage but is not a requirement:

  • Translational or application-oriented research.

  • Interdisciplinary collaboration.

  • Collaboration with industry, hospitals, healthcare organizations, public authorities or other external partners.

  • Development and validation of methods, technologies, prototypes or proof-of-concept studies.

  • Intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or commercialization.

  • Participation in applications for research or innovation funding.

  • Innovation-oriented teaching or student activities.

As the positions are aimed at early-career researchers, applicants will be assessed in relation to their career stage. Applicants are not required to demonstrate an established innovation track record. A convincing motivation and a realistic plan for developing innovative research will be central to the assessment.

 

The research and innovation environment

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy provides a highly collaborative environment that brings together experimental, computational and theoretical research. The department offers broad opportunities for collaboration within research, innovation, funding applications and teaching.

The successful candidates will become part of the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and will have opportunities to collaborate with researchers across the department, the Faculty of Science, other faculties at SDU and relevant external organizations.

SDU provides access to an extensive innovation ecosystem that supports researchers in developing ideas and exploring pathways towards application and impact. Depending on the individual project, this may include support for innovation funding, collaboration with external partners, intellectual property, technology maturation, entrepreneurship and business development.

The assistant professors will be expected to contribute actively to this environment and to help strengthen connections between excellent research, education, innovation and society.

 

What we offer

The successful candidates will be offered:

  • The opportunity to establish an independent research and innovation profile in a supportive academic environment.

  • Access to interdisciplinary research communities and relevant experimental, analytical and computational infrastructure.

  • Opportunities to collaborate with academic and external partners.

  • Support for the development of applications for research and innovation funding.

  • Access to relevant mentoring, career-development and pedagogical activities.

  • Opportunities to contribute to the further development of innovation within the department’s research and educational programmes.

title: Senior Partnership & Business Development
description:
Senior Partnership & Business Development

Vil du med på en vækstrejse i en digital startup, hvor dine idéer og resultater i høj grad er med til at definere vejen? Vi søger en struktureret, analytisk og kommercielt tænkende profil, der kan udvikle vores samarbejdspartnere og skabe stærke resultater gennem strategiske partnerskaber.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Strategisk rådgivning: Være en aktiv sparringspartner, der kan udfordre eksisterende tilgange og rådgive om, hvordan samarbejdet kan skabe størst mulig værdi for partnerens forretning.

  • Planlægning og eksekvering: Udarbejde aktivitetsplaner og omsætte strategiske mål til konkrete marketingaktiviteter og kommercielle initiativer.

  • Data og performance: Analysere resultater på tværs af vores partnere, egne aktiviteter og brugernes adfærd. Forstå, hvad tallene fortæller, identificere mønstre og undersøge, hvad der driver resultaterne.

  • Brugerindsigt og adfærd: Forstå, hvad der motiverer vores brugere, og hvordan de reagerer på forskellige indsatser. Hvilken betydning har eksempelvis billeder, budskaber, formater og sendetidspunkter for engagement og handling?

Det handler om at kunne se sammenhængene og bruge dem aktivt. Vi skal med andre ord ikke blot kunne aflæse vores data, men også forstå, hvad der ligger bag tallene, stille de rigtige spørgsmål og omsætte indsigterne til handling. Det kræver en person, der kombinerer analytisk nysgerrighed med kommerciel forståelse og evnen til at se det større perspektiv.

  • Er analytisk og motiveres af at arbejde med data, indsigter og performance.

  • Er nysgerrig på brugeradfærd og interesseret i at forstå, hvad der driver engagement og handling.

  • Kan se sammenhængen mellem marketing, brugeradfærd og salg.

  • Har forståelse for at arbejde med hypoteser, tests og løbende optimering.

  • Tør udfordre eksisterende løsninger og komme med nye idéer.

  • Er struktureret og god til at omsætte strategier til konkrete handlinger.

Herudover vil det være en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til både affiliate- og bureauverdenen.

Men vigtigst af alt er det, at du er nysgerrig på forretningen, menneskene og dataene bag resultaterne. Du skal have lyst til at forstå, hvorfor noget virker, hvordan vi kan gøre det endnu bedre, og hvordan vi skaber værdi for både vores samarbejdspartnere, brugere og virksomheden.

Derudover får du:

Når du sender din ansøgning og dit CV, accepterer du, at vi opbevarer dine personlige oplysninger, så længe rekrutteringsprocessen varer.

Studiz er en dansk virksomhed, skabt og drevet af studerende, med det formål at gøre hverdagen sjovere, billigere og enklere for verificerede studerende. title: Teamspective: Account Executive (Denmark or Sweden)
description: **Type:** Full-time, permanent**Location:** Helsinki, Copenhagen, Stockholm**Application deadline:** Tue 1.12.2026Join Teamspective, a fast-growing Finnish AI-native SaaS company transforming how organizations lead their people. We're hiring two Account Executives to drive our expansion into Denmark and Sweden!**Your role with us**Teamspective is on a mission to make great leadership a competitive advantage. Our AI-native platform turns employee insights into practical guidance for leaders routines, helping managers lead better every day. With strong growth, proven customer success across the Nordics, and ambitious international plans, we're now ready to accelerate our expansion into Denmark and Sweden.As our **Account Executive for Denmark**, you'll build on our existing customer relationships and strong references, including **Danfoss**, to expand Teamspective's presence in the Danish market. As our **Account Executive for Sweden**, youll focus on opening new opportunities and growing our customer base in a market where were already working with companies like **Hitta.se**. In either role, you'll take ownership of your market and help shape how Teamspective grows internationally.**Your key responsibilities will include:**- Owning the full sales cycle, from prospecting and pipeline building to closing deals, with a focus on mid-sized and large organizations. - Leading discovery meetings and product demos to uncover customer needs and demonstrate Teamspective's value. - Driving B2B sales processes from initial contact to negotiations, procurement, and closing. - Building trusted relationships with HR leaders and other decision-makers through consultative selling. - Developing your market approach and identifying opportunities to scale Teamspective's presence in your country. You'll work closely with our CRO and CEO, existing sales team, and colleagues in customer success and product development, giving you direct access to commercial leadership and the expertise behind our product.Looking further ahead, as Teamspective's presence in your market grows, you could have the opportunity to step into a Country Manager role and build and lead your own local sales team.**Who we're looking for**You're a commercially driven, hands-on sales professional who enjoys opening doors, building relationships, and turning opportunities into results. You know how to engage HR decision-makers and understand what drives their business. You bring strong Danish or Swedish language skills and an understanding of your respective market. Above all, you thrive on taking ownership and are excited to build and grow a market over the long term.**What we expect from you:**- At least 3 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably SaaS, technology, or HR-related - Experience in solution sales to a clearly defined B2B customer segment, with the ability to understand customer challenges and demonstrate business value - A proven track record in new business acquisition and managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing deals - A proactive, independent approach to sales and the drive to build your own pipeline and develop a market - Excellent Danish skills for the Denmark position, or excellent Swedish skills for the Sweden position, alongside good English skills **What we consider a plus:**- Experience selling HR technology solutions or other B2B solutions to HR decision-makers, with an understanding of their business challenges - An established network of HR leaders and decision-makers in Denmark or Sweden - Previous experience opening new markets or developing sales operations in an international growth company **What we offer you:**- Build your market and shape the go-to-market strategy with real ownership. - Sell an AI-native solution that helps organizations turn better leadership into a competitive advantage. - Work alongside experienced leaders and a tight-knit team that moves fast and has your back. - Drive international growth with a proven product, strong customer references, and room to make your mark. - Grow toward a potential Country Manager role and eventually build and lead your own local team. **Practicalities:**These are full-time, permanent positions in which you will be employed directly by Teamspective. You can be based in Helsinki or your respective target market, Copenhagen or Stockholm, after the initial onboarding period. The preferred starting date is as soon as possible in early 2027.**Onboarding:**The role requires you to spend your first 3–6 months working in Helsinki. During this period, you will work closely with Teamspective's commercial, customer success, and product teams, build a deep understanding of the product, and start developing your market from day one. Teamspective will cover accommodation in Helsinki for candidates relocating temporarily. After onboarding, you can work from Helsinki or your respective target country, with regular visits to Helsinki.**Compensation:**The base salary in this position starts from 4000 €/month, complemented by an uncapped commission. As an indicative estimate, on-target earnings (OTE) could range from 90-110 000 euros annually, depending on sales performance. The commission model also includes incentives for qualified meetings during the probationary period. You'll also join Teamspective's employee stock option program after your probationary period. As you grow into a Sales Manager or Country Manager role, there may be opportunities to negotiate a larger equity stake.**Ready to build success in a new market?**Please submit your CV and brief motivation statement by the latest Tue 1st of December 2026 via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/396854/create/.Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

title: PhD in Electrolyte Solvation and Interphase Engineering for Rechargeable Calcium Batteries
description:
At AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from 1st of March 2027 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasksYou will develop and investigate non-aqueous liquid electrolytes for rechargeable calcium batteries, focusing on how Ca2+ solvation, ion pairing and interphase formation govern electrochemical reversibility. Your work will contribute to a complementary research programme on calcium-battery electrode materials and cell development at AAU Energy.

You will systematically vary salt chemistry, solvent composition and concentration within selected electrolyte families. Physicochemical measurements and spectroscopic analysis will be used to examine electrolyte coordination environments and ion association. These investigations will guide the selection of formulations for detailed electrochemical and interfacial studies.

A central part of the work will be the design and evaluation of calcium plating and stripping experiments, including measurements of coulombic efficiency, polarization and cycling stability under defined conditions. You will use appropriate controls and complementary analyses to verify metallic calcium deposition and distinguish it from electrolyte decomposition or other electrochemical reactions. You will investigate electrode interphase composition and evolution using XPS, supported by electron microscopy and, where appropriate, ToF-SIMS for morphology and species distribution. Raman spectroscopy, complemented by NMR where relevant, will probe electrolyte coordination and ion association. Targeted MD simulations may clarify Ca²⁺ solvation and ion pairing. Correlating these findings with electrochemical performance will establish mechanism-based guidelines for electrolyte formulation and selection.

Working closely with the PhD researcher developing cathode and calcium-alloying anode materials, you will assess selected electrode–electrolyte combinations and contribute to reproducible coin-cell evaluation. You will also contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, teaching, supervision of student projects and departmental dissemination activities.

The position is offered in relation to the Batteries research group, and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Power Electronics Systems Integration and Materials”.

Your competencies Applicants are expected to hold an M.Sc. degree in chemistry, materials science, physics, chemical engineering, or a closely related discipline. Candidates should have a solid scientific background and preferably hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas: electrochemistry, electrolyte formulation and preparation, battery testing and characterization, or the handling of air- and moisture-sensitive materials under controlled environments. A strong interest in electrochemical energy storage, interfacial chemistry, spectroscopic characterization techniques, and quantitative experimental data analysis is highly desirable.

Experience with advanced characterization techniques, particularly spectroscopy and surface analysis, will be considered an advantage. Familiarity with molecular dynamics (MD) simulations or other computational approaches for investigating electrolyte properties is beneficial but not essential, as the position is primarily focused on experimental research.

Excellent written and spoken English communication skills, together with the ability to collaborate effectively in a multidisciplinary and international research environment, are essential.

Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we areAAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real world energy challenges.

Aalborg University has been ranked as the best university in Europe within energy research and is among the very best universities worldwide in this field. At AAU Energy you will be part of a top international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges such as the green transition and future energy systems.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and with diverse national and disciplinary backgrounds, which creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as working language in both research and teaching, which supports the integration of international colleagues.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

title: Make Things Happen: We’re Hiring a Contract Manager Who Loves Action!
description:
Do you love the buzz of a fast-moving environment where you get real responsibility and make an impact from day one? Do you want to join a team of bold, curious and driven people who are building something extraordinary together? Does negotiating excite you? Then you might just be the Contract Manager we are looking for.

About us

Since 1981, Delta of Scandinavia has been crafting unforgettable travel experiences across the Nordics, from the magic of Iceland’s northern lights to the timeless beauty of Norway’s fjords. Luxury escapes, wild adventures, sustainable journeys: all designed with passion, creativity and a true love for the North.

What do we offer

Join a young, international team where ideas travel fast and every day feels different.

Work in a vibrant environment that inspires creativity, collaboration and fun.

Grow fast, with real career opportunities and intense hands-on training that will boost your skills from day one.

Your responsibilities

As Contract Manager you negotiate and manage our supplier agreements, securing the best commercial conditions and building strong partnerships. Your work supports product quality, operational efficiency and our wider company objectives.

You will be involved in many exciting areas, including:

•      Identify, collect, analyse and negotiate a wide variety of contracts with suppliers. Optimise every agreement to maximise value and keep Delta competitive.

•      Ensure that all contractual terms align with company standards and objectives.

•      Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with suppliers, and act as the main point of contact for contractual matters.

•      Foster collaboration with suppliers to improve product quality and commercial outcomes.

•      Troubleshoot contract-related issues.

•      Make sure that booking procedures with suppliers work well, and identify and implement solutions that improve processes and efficiency.

•      Be in contact with the Department Managers to establish the strategy for the product and stay aware of the departments’ needs.

•      Contribute insights that support product strategy and development.

•      Collaborate with destination partners to stay up to date on product knowledge and market developments, and make sure Delta is involved in the strategies of the Tourist Boards and DMOs, including invitations to events and FAM trips.

•      Keep the communication about the product flowing between staff at all times: exchange news and keep a regular update.

What we expect from you

You bring an exceptional work ethic and a strong sense of urgency. You are driven by ambition and always push yourself to reach the highest standards. You take full ownership of your work, and you are proactive, reliable and committed to delivering results. At the same time, you stay humble and share our enthusiasm for creating and growing new ventures.

We love working from the office: it is where teamwork, creativity and growth truly thrive, when we are together in person. From 1 December 2026 our office will be located at Axeltårn: difficult to find a better location in town.

title: Postdoc in Dynamic Modelling, Simulation and Optimization of Power-to-X Processes
description:
At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a 24-month postdoctoral position in Dynamic Modelling, Simulation and Optimization of Power-to-X Processes is available from 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The project is primarily rooted in process engineering while also addressing interactions between Power-to-X plants and the electrical grid.

Your work tasksYou will develop and apply dynamic process models based on mass and energy balances, thermodynamics, reaction kinetics, and equipment behaviour to simulate integrated Power-to-X plants under changing operating conditions. The work will address renewable fuel production, particularly green methanol and sustainable aviation fuels through methanol-based and Fischer–Tropsch pathways. The work will focus on electrolysers, fuel-synthesis processes, energy storage, heat integration, and interactions with the electrical grid.

You will combine process simulation with operational optimization, process control, techno-economic assessment, and model validation to investigate flexible operation under varying renewable electricity generation and energy prices.

You will collaborate with academic and industrial partners, publish scientific results, contribute to project meetings and deliverables, and present findings at conferences and workshops. The position may also include limited teaching and supervision of bachelor’s and master’s students.

Your competenciesYou hold a PhD in chemical engineering, process engineering, or a closely related field, completed by the application deadline. You have documented research experience in process modelling and simulation, preferably including dynamic modelling of chemical or energy processes.

Hands-on experience with Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, or Aspen Dynamics will be considered a strong advantage. Experience with gPROMS, Modelica, or comparable process-simulation tools is also relevant. Strong skills in MATLAB, Python, or a similar computational environment are expected.

Experience with Power-to-X, renewable fuels, optimization, process control, model validation, techno-economic assessment, or grid-integrated energy systems will strengthen your profile.

You will work closely with industrial and international partners. Therefore, the ability to translate research into practical solutions and communicate effectively across disciplines is essential. We value candidates who are proactive, structured, collaborative, and motivated to publish high-quality research and contribute actively to project activities.

Who we areYou will join the Fluid & Process research group at AAU Energy, Campus Esbjerg, where you will become part of an international and interdisciplinary research environment combining process, chemical, energy and electrical engineering. The group works with modelling, simulation, control, optimization and experimental validation of fluid and energy systems, with applications including Power-to-X, carbon capture and utilization, green fuels and sector coupling. The working culture is collaborative and informal, with close interaction among academic staff, postdoctoral researchers, PhD fellows and students. We share an ambition to contribute to the green transition through research with practical relevance. We offer laboratory and workshop facilities, and a collaborative environment that supports innovation, knowledge sharing, and professional development.

Learn more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirements Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. You must submit a co-author statement, see template for co-author statement 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications if relevant.
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment. 

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.
