title: 2 Assistant Professor Positions (non-tenured) with a Focus on Innovation in Pharmacy or Medicinal Chemistry at SDU in Odense
description:
The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for 2 positions as Assistant Professor with a focus on innovation within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

The positions are expected to commence on 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. Each position is fixed-term for 3 years.

The positions are intended for talented early-career researchers who wish to develop an independent academic profile at the intersection of research, innovation and education. The successful candidates will conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry and contribute to translating scientific knowledge into solutions with potential value for patients, healthcare, society or the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors.

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science and is located at SDU’s main campus in Odense. The department is responsible for educational programmes in chemistry, medicinal chemistry and physics, as well as the bachelor’s programme in pharmacy. The successful candidates will join the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and become part of an interdisciplinary research environment with strong opportunities for collaboration across scientific fields and with external partners.

 

Research and innovation profile

The assistant professors will develop and conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear focus on innovation and application. Relevant research may include, but is not limited to, the discovery, design, development, formulation, delivery, analysis or evaluation of pharmaceutical substances, technologies and products. Innovation is understood broadly and may involve the development or application of new:

  • compounds, drug candidates or therapeutic concepts;

  • formulations, drug-delivery systems or pharmaceutical products;

  • experimental, analytical, computational or data-driven methods;

  • technologies, platforms, processes or research tools;

  • approaches to solving challenges relevant to patients, healthcare, society or industry.

The successful candidates are expected to identify the innovation potential of their research and contribute to its maturation and translation. Depending on the nature and stage of the research, this may include validation of concepts, development of prototypes or proof of concept, collaboration with relevant users and external partners, protection of intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or other pathways to application and impact.

The positions provide an opportunity for early-career researchers to develop an independent research and innovation profile. Applicants are therefore not expected to have an extensive record of patents, commercialization or entrepreneurship. Relevant previous experience is an advantage, but equal emphasis will be placed on the applicant’s scientific qualifications, motivation and potential to develop innovative research.

 

Roles and responsibilities

The assistant professors will be expected to:

  • Establish and develop an independent research programme within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear innovation perspective.

  • Conduct high-quality research and communicate the results through scientific publications, conferences and relevant outreach activities.

  • Identify and explore the scientific, societal and/or commercial potential of research ideas and results.

  • Develop research-based concepts, methods, technologies or solutions towards validation, proof of concept or application, where relevant.

  • Establish collaborations across disciplines and engage with relevant academic and external partners, such as companies, hospitals, healthcare professionals, public authorities, innovation environments or other users.

  • Apply for or contribute to applications for external research and innovation funding.

  • Contribute to teaching and course development within the department’s educational programmes, particularly pharmacy, medicinal chemistry and related areas.

  • Contribute to research-based and innovation-oriented teaching, including the involvement of students in relevant research and innovation activities.

  • Supervise and mentor bachelor’s and master’s students and, where relevant, contribute to the supervision of PhD students and other junior researchers.

  • Participate actively in the academic environment and contribute to the continued development of the department’s research, innovation and educational activities.

  • Participate in public engagement, knowledge exchange and other activities that strengthen the relationship between the university and the surrounding society.

 

The ideal candidate

We seek ambitious and collaborative early-career researchers with:

  • A PhD degree in pharmacy, medicinal chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry or another closely related field.

  • A strong scientific background relevant to research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

  • The ability and motivation to develop an independent research and innovation profile.

  • A clear interest in translating scientific knowledge into new concepts, methods, technologies, products, practices or other solutions.

  • The potential to identify relevant needs and opportunities and engage with academic and external partners.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills and an interest in interdisciplinary research.

  • Proficiency in spoken and written English.

 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage but is not a requirement:

  • Translational or application-oriented research.

  • Interdisciplinary collaboration.

  • Collaboration with industry, hospitals, healthcare organizations, public authorities or other external partners.

  • Development and validation of methods, technologies, prototypes or proof-of-concept studies.

  • Intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or commercialization.

  • Participation in applications for research or innovation funding.

  • Innovation-oriented teaching or student activities.

As the positions are aimed at early-career researchers, applicants will be assessed in relation to their career stage. Applicants are not required to demonstrate an established innovation track record. A convincing motivation and a realistic plan for developing innovative research will be central to the assessment.

 

The research and innovation environment

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy provides a highly collaborative environment that brings together experimental, computational and theoretical research. The department offers broad opportunities for collaboration within research, innovation, funding applications and teaching.

The successful candidates will become part of the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and will have opportunities to collaborate with researchers across the department, the Faculty of Science, other faculties at SDU and relevant external organizations.

SDU provides access to an extensive innovation ecosystem that supports researchers in developing ideas and exploring pathways towards application and impact. Depending on the individual project, this may include support for innovation funding, collaboration with external partners, intellectual property, technology maturation, entrepreneurship and business development.

The assistant professors will be expected to contribute actively to this environment and to help strengthen connections between excellent research, education, innovation and society.

 

What we offer

The successful candidates will be offered:

  • The opportunity to establish an independent research and innovation profile in a supportive academic environment.

  • Access to interdisciplinary research communities and relevant experimental, analytical and computational infrastructure.

  • Opportunities to collaborate with academic and external partners.

  • Support for the development of applications for research and innovation funding.

  • Access to relevant mentoring, career-development and pedagogical activities.

  • Opportunities to contribute to the further development of innovation within the department’s research and educational programmes.

title: Senior Analytical Chemist - BRIGHT
description:
The Novo Nordisk Foundation Biotechnology Research Institute for the Green Transition (BRIGHT) at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) aims to accelerate the development of biosolutions and strengthen the bio-based economy. The Biofoundry is an important part of BRIGHT and ensures effective development and implementation of strain design procedures in our design-build-test-learn workflow using big data and data science. The Analytics team is part of the Biofoundry and is providing reliable, accurate and high-throughput analytical services by means of state-of-the-art analytical techniques. We are now seeking a skilled Senior Analytical Chemist to join the team in providing BRIGHT with professional analytical services. The jobAs a Senior Analytical Chemist you will be part of a dynamic international team where you will be supporting the on-going activities and projects. You will be working together with another Analytical Chemist on our GC-based platforms, and you will be reporting directly to the Head of Analytics. Your immediate responsibilities will be:
  • Independently taking responsibility for handling incoming requests and projects in accordance to existing priorities
  • Running existing GC-MS and GC-FID methods
  • Setting up workflows (sample preparation, method development and data processing) for new GC-based analyses
  • Handling and reporting experimental data in reports, lab notebooks and LIMS-systems
  • Writing and maintaining SOPs
  • Flexibly and proactively helping other team members within the Analytics Team
  • Daily maintenance and troubleshooting of GC-MS and GC-FID equipment
Our expectations of youWe are looking for a colleague who likes to create results via positive and efficient teamwork. As part of this, you must thrive in a multi-disciplinary, multi-cultural and highly interactive environment where knowledge sharing, and collaboration are keys to succeed. Additionally, your CV comprises:
  • PhD in analytical chemistry or similar
  • Experience in independently running assigned projects (requiring GC analyses) from the planning phase to reporting of data
  • Hands on experience in running GC-MS and GC-FID systems
  • Experience in using Olfactory GC-MS will be considered an advantage
  • Experience in flavor profile analysis will be considered an advantage
  • Hands on experience in setting up and performing sample preparation of biological samples for GC-MS and GC-FID analyses
  • Proven experience in GC-MS and GC-FID method development and validation
  • Strong oral and written skills in English – our communication language is English
  • Flexibility, enthusiasm, responsibility, team spirit and excellent collaboration skills
  • Ability to keep calm in a hectic environment
What we offer in returnWe offer an interesting and challenging job in an international atmosphere with the focus on research, teaching, innovation and scientific advice for the benefit of the surrounding community. We place emphasis on a high level of professionalism among our staff, so skills development is an integral part of our organization. We offer a great flexibility in the position. In the area of technical and natural sciences, DTU is one of the leading research and education institutions in Europe.Salary and appointment termsThe appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): https://www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structuresThe position is a full-time position with a preferred starting date on February 1st, 2027 (or according to mutual agreement).The place of work will The Novo Nordisk Foundation Biotechnology Research Institute for the Green Transition (BRIGHT), DTU Lyngby Campus.Application and contactPlease submit your online application no later than Monday, 30 November 2026. Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. All applications must be written in English. If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Linda Ahonen, Head of Analytics, linaho@dtu.dk Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.The Novo Nordisk Foundation Biotechnology Research Institute for the Green Transition (BRIGHT) is a major initiative based at DTU that aims to accelerate the development of biosolutions and strengthen the bio-based economy. BRIGHT serves as a hub for academic and industrial partners working together to unlock the potential of bioproduction. BRIGHT focuses on three main areas: Sustainable materials (Developing bio-based alternatives to fossil-derived materials), Microbial foods (Innovating food production through microbial technologies), and Microorganisms for net-zero agriculture (Creating solutions to reduce greenhouse gas emissions in agriculture). The goal is to develop and scale innovative biosolutions within these areas, ultimately creating sustainable and competitive alternatives to fossil-based products and processes that can make significant contributions to reducing global greenhouse gas emissions.DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

title: Kok med smag for mere fritid?
description:
Café OVER-TID i Juelsminde søger endnu en kok, ernæringsassistent eller erfaren køkkenfaglig kollega.

Du holder af at lave ordentlig mad. Af at smage til, bage fra bunden og sende et måltid afsted, du er stolt af. Og du vil gerne have tid til livet uden for køkkenet.

Hos Café OVER-TID får du begge dele: et køkken med forskellige opgaver og plads til dine idéer – og en arbejdsrytme med weekendvagt hver femte weekend, kun én aftenvagt om ugen i vinterhalvåret og mindre arbejde fra påske til september.

Fra surdej til selskaber

Du finder os i Juelsminde Hallerne, hvor Café OVER-TID samler mennesker om mad og fællesskab. Køkkenet laver både mad til caféens gæster, Take Away, mad ud af huset, selskaber, møder og events. Vi står også for frokostordninger til virksomheder, blandt andre JUAL.

Vi laver mad fra bunden og bager selv vores brød – gerne med surdej. Her får du brugt dit håndværk på tværs af hverdagsmad, caféretter og selskabsmenuer. Og du får mulighed for at præge menuerne, ugens retter og måden, vi arbejder på.

God mad. Og tid til andet.

Arbejdet følger husets sæson. Vi arbejder mere om vinteren og har nedsat arbejdstid fra påske til september, så der er ekstra tid til at nyde de varme dage.

●     Weekendvagt hver femte weekend.

●     Kun én aftenvagt om ugen i vinterhalvåret.

●     Færre arbejdstimer fra påske til september.

●     Et lille team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og giver plads til faglige input.

●     Indflydelse på maden og arbejdsgangene i køkkenet.

Der er også travle dage og arrangementer, der kræver, at vi løfter sammen. Du får en hverdag med både planlagt produktion og gæster i huset.

Du kan dit håndværk – og tager ansvar

Du er kok, ernæringsassistent, cater eller har solid erfaring fra et professionelt køkken. Det afgørende er, at du kan lave velsmagende mad fra bunden og arbejde selvstændigt med kvalitet og overblik.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

●     Kan planlægge og tilberede mad til både daglig drift og arrangementer.

●     Har styr på hygiejne, egenkontrol og orden i køkkenet.

●     Tager initiativ og har lyst til at bidrage med idéer.

●     Hjælper kollegerne og bevarer overblikket, når der er flere ting i gang.

●     Trives med gæstekontakt og livet i et hus med børn, unge og voksne.

Du bliver en del af hverdagen i både køkkenet og caféen. Vi deles om opgaverne, så både maden, servicen og samarbejdet fungerer.

Lad os tage en snak

Har du lyst til at se køkkenet og høre mere om jobbet? Ring til centerchef Britta Roslyng på 44 14 36 10. Vi tager gerne en uformel snak over en kop kaffe.

Du kan også sende dit CV og et par linjer om dig selv og din køkkenerfaring til brg@jhacenter.dk.

Tiltrædelse snarest muligt. Vi holder samtaler løbende.

Arbejdssted: Café OVER-TID, Juelsminde Hallerne, Tofteskovvej 12, 7130 Juelsminde.

title: Kan du fikse næsten alt – undtagen vejret på Bakken?
description:
Så bliv vores nye handyman i Teltet på Bakken / STP Forlystelser!

Har du hænderne skruet rigtigt på – og mister du ikke fatningen, når døren binder, tagrenden driller, eller hegnet har fået sin helt egen mening om, hvordan det skal stå?

Er du typen, der hellere henter værktøjskassen end ringer efter nogen?

Så er du måske lige den kollega, vi står og mangler på Dyrehavsbakken! Vi søger en handyman med håndværksmæssig baggrund og/eller erfaring med vedligehold af bygninger og udendørsarealer – blandt andet til Korsbæk og Teltet på Bakken. Der, hvor Danmark griner allermest om sommeren.

Om jobbet – ingen dage er ens (tro os)

Som handyman refererer du til ledelsen og bliver en del af vores Service team.  

Service teamet står for den daglige vedligeholdelse, laver reparationer store som små og sørger for, at bygningerne står skarpt til både sommer- og julesæsonen.

Kort sagt: Hvis noget er løst, skævt, rustent, utæt eller bare træt – så er det dig (og teamet), der får det til at spille igen.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har en håndværksmæssig baggrund – måske er du uddannet tømrer, elektriker eller lignende (eller bare ham/hende alle ringer til, når noget er gået i stykker)

  • ikke er bange for højder – Bakken er flad, men det er vores bygninger heldigvis ikke

  • har det fint med, at der er lidt kontorarbejde og koordinering med eksterne leverandører indimellem.

  • har det fint med, at der er lidt kontorarbejde og koordinering med eksterne leverandører indimellem.

  • trives i et team og løser praktiske problemer konstruktivt og effektivt – gerne med et smil og en dårlig vits i værktøjsbæltet

  • kan bevare overblikket, selv når der er tre projekter i gang og fjerde banker på.

  • Bonuspoint: har kørekort til truck og lift – det er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Ordentlige forhold: Løn efter kvalifikationer inkl. pension og sundhedsforsikring – vi passer på dem, der passer på Bakken

  • Smukke omgivelser: En arbejdsplads midt i Dyrehaven med kolleger i både Cirkusrevyen og Korsbæk

  • Ægte håndværksglæde: Gode grin, frisk luft og opgaver, du faktisk kan se resultatet af, når du går hjem

  • Invitationer til flere sociale arrangementer og events.

Der må forventes skæve arbejdstider med weekend- og aftenarbejde i de perioder, hvor Bakken har åbent. Til gengæld lover vi, at du aldrig kommer til at kede dig.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send et par linjer om dig selv + dit CV til Anette Hjorth på anette@cirkusrevyen.dk

Mærk mailen: Handyman

Ansøgningsfrist: 1. december

Om Teltet på Bakken / STP

Vi er en familieejet virksomhed, som står for drift og vedligeholdelse af Teltet på Bakken, Korsbæk, 2 restauranter, 9 kørende forlystelser og 3 spilforretninger på Dyrehavsbakken. Vores vigtigste opgave? At give vores gæster en sjov og uforglemmelig oplevelse – hvor sikkerheden altid er i top.

Teltet på Bakken / STP Forlystelser er en del af den største koncern på Bakken og er tæt knyttet til både Cirkusrevyen og Korsbæk. Du bliver en del af en helt særlig arbejdsplads, hvor hver dag byder på nye opgaver og udfordringer i et dynamisk miljø. Mange opgaver løses i fællesskab, så dine faglige kompetencer og samarbejdsevner bliver helt centrale.

Jobbet foregår i unikke og fantastiske omgivelser midt i Dyrehaven – hvor kontorudsigten altså er grønne træer og glade gæster.

title: Senior Partnership & Business Development
description:
Senior Partnership & Business Development

Vil du med på en vækstrejse i en digital startup, hvor dine idéer og resultater i høj grad er med til at definere vejen? Vi søger en struktureret, analytisk og kommercielt tænkende profil, der kan udvikle vores samarbejdspartnere og skabe stærke resultater gennem strategiske partnerskaber.

Studiz er bl.a. landets største platform for studierabat til verificerede studerende med mere end 400.000 medlemmer. Vores platform giver virksomheder mulighed for at opbygge en tidlig relation til fremtidens mest købestærke kundesegment. Se mere på www.studiz.dk.

Vi arbejder med samspillet mellem brands og studerende, og det er i dette krydsfelt, at din rolle skal udfolde sig i tæt samarbejde med vores CMO.

Du får budgetansvar for din egen portefølje og vil samtidig være den drivende kraft i flere interne projekter, hvor du skal hjælpe og vejlede vores praktikanter og studentermedhjælpere.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Strategisk rådgivning: Være en aktiv sparringspartner, der kan udfordre eksisterende tilgange og rådgive om, hvordan samarbejdet kan skabe størst mulig værdi for partnerens forretning.

  • Planlægning og eksekvering: Udarbejde aktivitetsplaner og omsætte strategiske mål til konkrete marketingaktiviteter og kommercielle initiativer.

  • Data og performance: Analysere resultater på tværs af vores partnere, egne aktiviteter og brugernes adfærd. Forstå, hvad tallene fortæller, identificere mønstre og undersøge, hvad der driver resultaterne.

  • Brugerindsigt og adfærd: Forstå, hvad der motiverer vores brugere, og hvordan de reagerer på forskellige indsatser. Hvilken betydning har eksempelvis billeder, budskaber, formater og sendetidspunkter for engagement og handling?

  • Test og optimering: Opstille hypoteser, teste nye initiativer og evaluere effekten. Bruge resultaterne til løbende at forbedre vores aktiviteter og skabe bedre resultater for både partnere og brugere.

En central del af stillingen er at forstå og udvikle samspillet mellem tre områder: vores partnere, vores egen forretning og vores brugere.

Det handler om at kunne se sammenhængene og bruge dem aktivt. Vi skal med andre ord ikke blot kunne aflæse vores data, men også forstå, hvad der ligger bag tallene, stille de rigtige spørgsmål og omsætte indsigterne til handling. Det kræver en person, der kombinerer analytisk nysgerrighed med kommerciel forståelse og evnen til at se det større perspektiv.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har erfaring fra en lignende stilling inden for marketing og dermed både kommerciel og strategisk forståelse samt dokumenterede resultater.

  • Er analytisk og motiveres af at arbejde med data, indsigter og performance.

  • Er nysgerrig på brugeradfærd og interesseret i at forstå, hvad der driver engagement og handling.

  • Kan se sammenhængen mellem marketing, brugeradfærd og salg.

  • Har forståelse for at arbejde med hypoteser, tests og løbende optimering.

  • Tør udfordre eksisterende løsninger og komme med nye idéer.

  • Er struktureret og god til at omsætte strategier til konkrete handlinger.

Herudover vil det være en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til både affiliate- og bureauverdenen.

Men vigtigst af alt er det, at du er nysgerrig på forretningen, menneskene og dataene bag resultaterne. Du skal have lyst til at forstå, hvorfor noget virker, hvordan vi kan gøre det endnu bedre, og hvordan vi skaber værdi for både vores samarbejdspartnere, brugere og virksomheden.

Derudover får du:

  • Gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling.

  • Sundhedsforsikring.

  • Stor arbejdsfrihed.

  • Sociale arrangementer.

Ansøgning med relevante bilag sendes til job@studiz.dk

Ansøgninger modtages løbende, og vi indkalder til samtaler, indtil den rette kandidat er fundet. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Sille Kaalund på tel. 50 40 62 80.

Når du sender din ansøgning og dit CV, accepterer du, at vi opbevarer dine personlige oplysninger, så længe rekrutteringsprocessen varer.

Studiz er en dansk virksomhed, skabt og drevet af studerende, med det formål at gøre hverdagen sjovere, billigere og enklere for verificerede studerende. Siden 2013 har Studiz hjulpet virksomheder med at opbygge loyalitet og gjort det nemmere for studerende at få adgang til studierabatter, bl.a. via det personlige digitale studiekort i Studiz-app'en.

title: Cleaning Assistant / Supervisor
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a reliable and professional Cleaning Assistant / Supervisor who can both perform

hands-on cleaning duties and effectively lead and support a team of cleaning assistants. The ideal

candidate combines strong practical cleaning skills with the ability to organize work, maintain high

standards, and guide colleagues.

This is a dual-role position where you will work alongside the team while taking responsibility for daily

Supervisory Duties

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in commercial, office, hotel, or healthcare cleaning

• Knowledge of cleaning products, equipment, and safety procedures

• Basic leadership or team-lead experience

• [Any local language requirements, if relevant]

What We Offer

• Competitive salary

• Opportunities for professional development

• Supportive team environment

title: Bahez Barbershop søger erfaren Daglig Manager med ansvar for drift, personale og kundeservice i Næstved
description:

title: Supervisor / Team Leader wanted for growing cleaning and window cleaning department
description:
We are looking for a dedicated supervisor / team leader to strengthen our team and participate in the continued growth of our company. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is eager to lead the daily operations of our cleaning and window cleaning department, with customers from Roskilde to Køge to Helsingør.

As supervisor / team leader, you will play a crucial role in maintaining and elevating the standard of the work we deliver to our customers.

Your tasks will include, among other things:

  • Training and supervision of employees

  • Ensuring high service standards

  • 37-hour work week

  • Great colleagues

  • Prioritizes delivering high-quality results

  • Able to work independently and in a structured manner

title: Teamspective: Account Executive (Denmark or Sweden)
description: **Type:** Full-time, permanent**Location:** Helsinki, Copenhagen, Stockholm**Application deadline:** Tue 1.12.2026Join Teamspective, a fast-growing Finnish AI-native SaaS company transforming how organizations lead their people. We're hiring two Account Executives to drive our expansion into Denmark and Sweden!**Your role with us**Teamspective is on a mission to make great leadership a competitive advantage. Our AI-native platform turns employee insights into practical guidance for leaders routines, helping managers lead better every day. With strong growth, proven customer success across the Nordics, and ambitious international plans, we're now ready to accelerate our expansion into Denmark and Sweden.As our **Account Executive for Denmark**, you'll build on our existing customer relationships and strong references, including **Danfoss**, to expand Teamspective's presence in the Danish market. As our **Account Executive for Sweden**, youll focus on opening new opportunities and growing our customer base in a market where were already working with companies like **Hitta.se**. In either role, you'll take ownership of your market and help shape how Teamspective grows internationally.**Your key responsibilities will include:**- Owning the full sales cycle, from prospecting and pipeline building to closing deals, with a focus on mid-sized and large organizations. - Leading discovery meetings and product demos to uncover customer needs and demonstrate Teamspective's value. - Driving B2B sales processes from initial contact to negotiations, procurement, and closing. - Building trusted relationships with HR leaders and other decision-makers through consultative selling. - Developing your market approach and identifying opportunities to scale Teamspective's presence in your country. You'll work closely with our CRO and CEO, existing sales team, and colleagues in customer success and product development, giving you direct access to commercial leadership and the expertise behind our product.Looking further ahead, as Teamspective's presence in your market grows, you could have the opportunity to step into a Country Manager role and build and lead your own local sales team.**Who we're looking for**You're a commercially driven, hands-on sales professional who enjoys opening doors, building relationships, and turning opportunities into results. You know how to engage HR decision-makers and understand what drives their business. You bring strong Danish or Swedish language skills and an understanding of your respective market. Above all, you thrive on taking ownership and are excited to build and grow a market over the long term.**What we expect from you:**- At least 3 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably SaaS, technology, or HR-related - Experience in solution sales to a clearly defined B2B customer segment, with the ability to understand customer challenges and demonstrate business value - A proven track record in new business acquisition and managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing deals - A proactive, independent approach to sales and the drive to build your own pipeline and develop a market - Excellent Danish skills for the Denmark position, or excellent Swedish skills for the Sweden position, alongside good English skills **What we consider a plus:**- Experience selling HR technology solutions or other B2B solutions to HR decision-makers, with an understanding of their business challenges - An established network of HR leaders and decision-makers in Denmark or Sweden - Previous experience opening new markets or developing sales operations in an international growth company **What we offer you:**- Build your market and shape the go-to-market strategy with real ownership. - Sell an AI-native solution that helps organizations turn better leadership into a competitive advantage. - Work alongside experienced leaders and a tight-knit team that moves fast and has your back. - Drive international growth with a proven product, strong customer references, and room to make your mark. - Grow toward a potential Country Manager role and eventually build and lead your own local team. **Practicalities:**These are full-time, permanent positions in which you will be employed directly by Teamspective. You can be based in Helsinki or your respective target market, Copenhagen or Stockholm, after the initial onboarding period. The preferred starting date is as soon as possible in early 2027.**Onboarding:**The role requires you to spend your first 3–6 months working in Helsinki. During this period, you will work closely with Teamspective's commercial, customer success, and product teams, build a deep understanding of the product, and start developing your market from day one. Teamspective will cover accommodation in Helsinki for candidates relocating temporarily. After onboarding, you can work from Helsinki or your respective target country, with regular visits to Helsinki.**Compensation:**The base salary in this position starts from 4000 €/month, complemented by an uncapped commission. As an indicative estimate, on-target earnings (OTE) could range from 90-110 000 euros annually, depending on sales performance. The commission model also includes incentives for qualified meetings during the probationary period. You'll also join Teamspective's employee stock option program after your probationary period. As you grow into a Sales Manager or Country Manager role, there may be opportunities to negotiate a larger equity stake.**Ready to build success in a new market?**Please submit your CV and brief motivation statement by the latest Tue 1st of December 2026 via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/396854/create/.Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

title: Nurse or Cardiac Technician with experience analyzing ECG reports
description:
At Cortrium, we are improving cardiac diagnostics with innovative and user-friendly ECG technology used by healthcare professionals in over 20 countries.

We are looking for a dedicated nurse or Cardiac Technician with experience in ECG analysis and interpretation to strengthen our team and contribute to our continued growth.

About the role

Our ECG analysis department is an international team of 35 dedicated colleagues, including cardiac nurses, cardiac technicians, lab technicians, cardiologists, and general practitioners. We offer regular training sessions to promote learning and professional development.

 Your responsibilities:

  • Quality review of ECG analyses

  • Provide feedback to our R&D team to help further develop our ECG analysis system and ensure optimal results for both healthcare professionals and patients

About you

Your qualifications:

  • Background as a cardiac nurse or ECG/cardiac technician

  • At least two years of experience in cardiology

  • Team player with the drive to make a difference

  • Systematic and detail-oriented

  • Fluent in English, and/or Danish

What we offer

Hours, and work environment: 

  • Part-time or full-time

  • Possibility to work partly from home after onboarding

  • A positive and respectful work environment with a focus on work-life balance

  • Creative office located in Høje Taastrup, just outside Copenhagen, with parking, train access, and startup vibes. Enjoy daily meals, great coffee, and a bright, inspiring workspace

About Cortrium

We offer a complete long-term ECG solution and are dedicated to making ECG simple – from recording to analysis. Our cable-free and lightweight C3⁺ Holter monitor ensures high comfort for patients, and we deliver long-term ECG reports verified by cardiology experts. We support healthcare professionals in over 20 countries and have produced more than 500,000 reports.

For further information about the position please reach out to:

Jette Bruus Beciri

People Leader ECG Quality Control

qc@cortrium.com

 

To apply for the job please send your CV and Application to:

qc@cortrium.com

title: Produktionsmedarbejder søges med hurtig opstart
description:
Har du hænderne skruet godt på? Vi søger hjælp til produktion. 

For vores kunde HTM søger vi en ekstra medarbejder til produktionsarbejde med hurtig opstart.

Du bliver en del af produktionen, hvor din primære opgave bliver at hjælpe med håndtering og løft af døre både før og efter lakering.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Løft og håndtering af døre før og efter lakering.

  • Sikre, at dørene håndteres forsigtigt og ikke får skrammer eller andre skader.

  • Hjælpe med at holde et godt flow i produktionen.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har et godt overblik og er opmærksom på detaljerne.

  • Er forsigtig og omhyggelig i dit arbejde.

  • Har fysikken til at håndtere og løfte døre i løbet af arbejdsdagen.

  • Er mødestabil og klar på praktisk produktionsarbejde.

  • Kan trives med arbejdsopgaver, der til tider kan være trivielle og ensformige.

Det er vigtigt, at du arbejder omhyggeligt, da selv mindre skrammer på dørene kan betyde, at emnerne må kasseres.

Praktisk information

Du vil som udgangspunkt blive ansat af Temp-Team A/S i et vikarforløb.

  • Opstart: Hurtigst muligt.

  • Varighed: Som udgangspunkt året ud.

  • Løn: 160 kr/t. + fritvalg og pension

  • Arbejdstid: Mandag - torsdag 7.00 -15.45 Fredag: 7.00 -12.20

Du kan også skrive en kort tekst om dig selv i ansøgningsteksten ovenfor. Temp-Team A/S varetager denne rekruttering og al henvendelse skal gå gennem Temp-Team.Grundet GDPR modtager vi ikke cv og ansøgning via e-mail.Temp-TeamTemp-Team A/S er et landsdækkende rekrutterings- og bemandingsbureau. title: Servicemand søges – erfaring er ikke et krav, men gåpåmod er!
description:
Jes Pedersen Sorø ApS søger en ny kollega til vores serviceteam.

Har du hænderne skruet rigtigt på, og kan du lide et praktisk arbejde med forskellige opgaver? Så har vi måske jobbet til dig!

Vi søger en servicemand, der primært skal beskæftige sig med slibning af betongulve samt mindre reparationer og udbedringer i forbindelse med vores beton- og kloakarbejde.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Slibning og efterbehandling af betongulve

  • Mindre reparationer og udbedringer af betonarbejde

  • Mindre service- og reparationsopgaver i forbindelse med kloakarbejde

  • Diverse forefaldende praktiske opgaver

 

Hvem er du?

Du behøver ikke have erfaring med netop disse arbejdsopgaver. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære og trives med praktisk arbejde.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har hænderne skruet rigtigt på og er praktisk anlagt

  • Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og kan tage fat

  • Har lyst til at lære nye arbejdsopgaver

  • Er omhyggelig og sætter en ære i at levere et ordentligt stykke arbejde

  • Har kørekort (B) og trailerkørekort (B/E) – begge dele er et krav

Erfaring fra bygge- og anlægsbranchen er en fordel, men bestemt ikke en nødvendighed.

title: Kom du ikke ind på drømmestudiet? No worries, vi har en plan "B" klar til dig i udlandet! Book et kald med os i dag!
description:
Kom du ikke ind på drømmestudiet - No worries – vi har en plan B klar til dig.

Du tjekkede optagelse.dk, loggede ind, og der stod det: ikke optaget. Surt, ja. Men lige nu har du faktisk flere muligheder, end du tror.

Spørgsmålet er bare: skal efteråret og vinteren gå med at vente på næste ansøgningsrunde – eller skal den bruges på noget, der faktisk rykker dig?

Forestil dig i stedet, at du pakker kufferten og tager til udlandet for at arbejde en periode. Varmere vejr. Nye mennesker. Oplevelser, du kommer til at fortælle om resten af livet.

Men hvad giver det egentlig dig, ud over sol og gode oplevelser?

Et arbejde i udlandet er ikke bare en pause fra hverdagen – det er faktisk noget af det, der skiller dig ud fra alle de andre ansøgere, næste gang du søger ind på studiet (eller søger job).

Det løfter dit CV markantArbejdsgivere og optagelsesudvalg elsker at se selvstændighed. At du har boet i et andet land, klaret dig selv, tilpasset dig en ny kultur og et nyt sprog – det viser, at du kan tage ansvar og løse problemer, uden at mor og far står lige bag dig. Det er præcis den type erfaring, der får et CV til at skille sig ud fra bunken.

Du bygger et netværk, der rækker ud over DanmarkDu kommer til at arbejde sammen med mennesker fra hele verden – andre unge i samme situation som dig, lokale kolleger, ledere med international erfaring. Det netværk kan du trække på resten af livet, uanset om det er til fremtidige jobs, praktikpladser eller bare venner, du kan besøge på den anden side af kloden.

Du udvikler kompetencer, du ikke lærer i et klasseværelseSprogkundskaber. Kulturel forståelse. Evnen til at begå dig i uvante situationer. Selvstændighed og ansvarlighed. Det er de "bløde" kompetencer, som rigtig mange arbejdsgivere efterspørger – og som er svære at få, hvis du bliver hjemme og venter.

Du finder ud af, hvad du faktisk vilMange af dem, vi sender ud, kommer hjem med en helt ny klarhed over, hvad de vil studere – eller opdager, at de brænder for noget helt andet, end de troede. Den erfaring er guld værd, når du skal træffe en beslutning, der påvirker de næste mange år af dit liv.

Kort sagt: den tid, du alligevel skal vente, kan enten gå med at se Netflix og tælle dage – eller den kan blive det, der gør dig til en stærkere kandidat, et mere selvstændigt menneske og en bedre version af dig selv, næste gang chancen byder sig.

Vi har jobmuligheder i bl.a.:

  • Spanien

  • Portugal

  • Grækenland

  • Bulgarien

  • Malta

  • Cypern

…og flere destinationer end det. Du står ikke med det hele selv – vi sørger for tryghed og fællesskab hele vejen, fra du lander til du rejser hjem igen.

Så: skal tiden bare gå? Eller skal du bruge den på noget, du faktisk får noget ud af?

  • Skriv til mig på cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com, så finder vi ud af, hvad der passer til dig.

title: Junior Marketing Consultant
description:
Junior Marketing Consultant 

Vil du med på en vækstrejse i en digital startup, hvor dine idéer og resultater i høj grad er med til at definere vejen? Vi søger en struktureret, analytisk og kommercielt tænkende profil, der trives i spændingsfeltet mellem datadrevet marketing og forretningsforståelse.

Studiz er bl.a. landets største platform for studierabat til verificerede studerende med mere end 400.000 medlemmer. Vores platform giver virksomheder mulighed for at opbygge en tidlig relation til fremtidens mest købestærke kundesegment. Se mere på www.studiz.dk.

Vi søger en eksekverende profil, der skal assistere vores CMO i hendes daglige arbejde. Vi er altså på jagt efter dig, der trives med at arbejde med hele processen – fra idé til implementering.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver:

  • Planlægning og eksekvering: Udarbejde aktivitetsplaner og omsætte strategiske mål til konkrete marketingaktiviteter og kommercielle initiativer.

  • Data og performance: Analysere resultaterne på tværs af vores partnere, egne aktiviteter og brugernes adfærd. Forstå, hvad tallene fortæller, identificere mønstre og undersøge, hvad der driver resultaterne.

  • Brugerindsigt og adfærd: Forstå, hvad der motiverer vores brugere, og hvordan de reagerer på forskellige indsatser.

  • Test og optimering: Opstille hypoteser, teste nye initiativer og evaluere effekten. Bruge resultaterne til løbende at forbedre vores aktiviteter og skabe bedre resultater for både partnere og brugere.

Det handler om at kunne se sammenhængene og bruge dem aktivt. Men vigtigst af alt handler det om, at du tør. Tør teste, stille spørgsmål og undersøge nye muligheder.

For os handler det mere om den rette profil og tilgang end om erfaring, da dit daglige arbejde vil foregå i tæt samarbejde med vores CMO.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Tør udfordre eksisterende løsninger, er idérig og udadvendt og har en "Jeg skal vise dem"-attitude.

  • Er struktureret og god til at omsætte strategier til konkrete handlinger.

  • Har forståelse for arbejdet med hypoteser, tests og løbende optimering.

  • Er nysgerrig på sammenhængen mellem marketing, brugeradfærd og salg.

  • Trives med ansvar og frihed.

Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig på Studiz, menneskene bag (de studerende) og dataene bag resultaterne. Du skal have lyst til at forstå, hvorfor noget virker, hvordan vi kan gøre det bedre, og hvordan vi skaber værdi for både vores samarbejdspartnere, brugere og virksomheden.

Hos Studiz bliver du en del af et ambitiøst team, der værdsætter en stærk testkultur, en datadrevet tilgang og en god portion humor i hverdagen.

Derudover får du:

  • Gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling.

  • Sundhedsforsikring.

  • Stor arbejdsfrihed.

  • Sociale arrangementer.

title: Bilsælger
description:
Sælger

Rørbæk Biler Hjørring A/S

Hjørring

Ønsker du et job i en moderne og udviklende bilforretning med kort fra tanke til handling, hvor du kan få frihed og ansvar til at skabe en god dynamik i vores salgsafdeling?

Vi søger en erfaren sælger, det er en fordel, hvis du har tilknytning til lokalområdet.

Er du serviceminded, en god købmand, tillidsvækkende og god til at kommunikere med mange forskellige kundetyper? Du er interesseret i at rådgive og vejlede kunderne og du har lyst til at opbygge et tillidsforhold til vores kunder.

Du er velstruktureret, bevarer overblikket og har godt styr på dine opgaver og processer.

Rørbæk Biler A/S, er en bilforretning med 38 års erfaring inden for brugte biler i alle klasser og priser. Vi har sammen med vores afdelinger i Frederikshavn mere end 190 spændende brugte biler på lager som bliver omsat mange gange årligt.

Dertil har Rørbæk Biler har eget leasingselskab Rørbæk Leasing, hvor der kan tilbydes alle former for leasing af både nye og brugte biler ud fra det nuværende varelager samt opkøb efter kundes ønsker.

Vi leder efter en bilrådgiver med følgende kvaliteter:

  • Salg af brugte biler, leasing og dertilhørende ydelser.

  • Salg af tillægsydelser som finansiering, forsikring, udvidet garantier og tilbehør.

  • Medbestemmende på indkøb således lageret passer med det der er efterspørgsel efter.

  • Aktiv på markedsføring, byder ind med ideer samt deltagelse i videoer m.m.

  • Skabe en pæn og indbydende forretning i form af placering af biler indvendigt og udvendigt.

  • Skabe opsøgende salg fra både eftermarked og virksomhedens kundekartotek.

  • Skabe en lokal synlighed med biler i form af at deltage til events m.m.

  • Fokus på kundetilfredsheden er i top blandt vores tidligere og kommende kunder.

  • Oprettelse af annoncer samt oprettelser af brugte biler til salg.

  • Du motiveres af at indfri dine egne gøremål & er selvstændig arbejdende.

  • Du kan arbejde selvstændigt og tilrettelægge din egen dag.

  • Du trives i et performancedrevet arbejdsmiljø.

  • Er resultatorienteret og ’’tænder’’ på et godt salg og opnå dine salgs mål.

  • Du er ikke bange for at tage fat og hjælpe dine kollager.

  • Længere Branche/salgserfaring er et krav

title: 2 Assistant Professor Positions (non-tenured) with a Focus on Innovation in Pharmacy or Medicinal Chemistry at SDU in Odense
description:
The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for 2 positions as Assistant Professor with a focus on innovation within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

The positions are expected to commence on 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. Each position is fixed-term for 3 years.

The positions are intended for talented early-career researchers who wish to develop an independent academic profile at the intersection of research, innovation and education. The successful candidates will conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry and contribute to translating scientific knowledge into solutions with potential value for patients, healthcare, society or the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors.

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science and is located at SDU’s main campus in Odense. The department is responsible for educational programmes in chemistry, medicinal chemistry and physics, as well as the bachelor’s programme in pharmacy. The successful candidates will join the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and become part of an interdisciplinary research environment with strong opportunities for collaboration across scientific fields and with external partners.

 

Research and innovation profile

The assistant professors will develop and conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear focus on innovation and application. Relevant research may include, but is not limited to, the discovery, design, development, formulation, delivery, analysis or evaluation of pharmaceutical substances, technologies and products. Innovation is understood broadly and may involve the development or application of new:

  • compounds, drug candidates or therapeutic concepts;

  • formulations, drug-delivery systems or pharmaceutical products;

  • experimental, analytical, computational or data-driven methods;

  • technologies, platforms, processes or research tools;

  • approaches to solving challenges relevant to patients, healthcare, society or industry.

The successful candidates are expected to identify the innovation potential of their research and contribute to its maturation and translation. Depending on the nature and stage of the research, this may include validation of concepts, development of prototypes or proof of concept, collaboration with relevant users and external partners, protection of intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or other pathways to application and impact.

The positions provide an opportunity for early-career researchers to develop an independent research and innovation profile. Applicants are therefore not expected to have an extensive record of patents, commercialization or entrepreneurship. Relevant previous experience is an advantage, but equal emphasis will be placed on the applicant’s scientific qualifications, motivation and potential to develop innovative research.

 

Roles and responsibilities

The assistant professors will be expected to:

  • Establish and develop an independent research programme within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear innovation perspective.

  • Conduct high-quality research and communicate the results through scientific publications, conferences and relevant outreach activities.

  • Identify and explore the scientific, societal and/or commercial potential of research ideas and results.

  • Develop research-based concepts, methods, technologies or solutions towards validation, proof of concept or application, where relevant.

  • Establish collaborations across disciplines and engage with relevant academic and external partners, such as companies, hospitals, healthcare professionals, public authorities, innovation environments or other users.

  • Apply for or contribute to applications for external research and innovation funding.

  • Contribute to teaching and course development within the department’s educational programmes, particularly pharmacy, medicinal chemistry and related areas.

  • Contribute to research-based and innovation-oriented teaching, including the involvement of students in relevant research and innovation activities.

  • Supervise and mentor bachelor’s and master’s students and, where relevant, contribute to the supervision of PhD students and other junior researchers.

  • Participate actively in the academic environment and contribute to the continued development of the department’s research, innovation and educational activities.

  • Participate in public engagement, knowledge exchange and other activities that strengthen the relationship between the university and the surrounding society.

 

The ideal candidate

We seek ambitious and collaborative early-career researchers with:

  • A PhD degree in pharmacy, medicinal chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry or another closely related field.

  • A strong scientific background relevant to research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

  • The ability and motivation to develop an independent research and innovation profile.

  • A clear interest in translating scientific knowledge into new concepts, methods, technologies, products, practices or other solutions.

  • The potential to identify relevant needs and opportunities and engage with academic and external partners.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills and an interest in interdisciplinary research.

  • Proficiency in spoken and written English.

 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage but is not a requirement:

  • Translational or application-oriented research.

  • Interdisciplinary collaboration.

  • Collaboration with industry, hospitals, healthcare organizations, public authorities or other external partners.

  • Development and validation of methods, technologies, prototypes or proof-of-concept studies.

  • Intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or commercialization.

  • Participation in applications for research or innovation funding.

  • Innovation-oriented teaching or student activities.

As the positions are aimed at early-career researchers, applicants will be assessed in relation to their career stage. Applicants are not required to demonstrate an established innovation track record. A convincing motivation and a realistic plan for developing innovative research will be central to the assessment.

 

The research and innovation environment

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy provides a highly collaborative environment that brings together experimental, computational and theoretical research. The department offers broad opportunities for collaboration within research, innovation, funding applications and teaching.

The successful candidates will become part of the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and will have opportunities to collaborate with researchers across the department, the Faculty of Science, other faculties at SDU and relevant external organizations.

SDU provides access to an extensive innovation ecosystem that supports researchers in developing ideas and exploring pathways towards application and impact. Depending on the individual project, this may include support for innovation funding, collaboration with external partners, intellectual property, technology maturation, entrepreneurship and business development.

The assistant professors will be expected to contribute actively to this environment and to help strengthen connections between excellent research, education, innovation and society.

 

What we offer

The successful candidates will be offered:

  • The opportunity to establish an independent research and innovation profile in a supportive academic environment.

  • Access to interdisciplinary research communities and relevant experimental, analytical and computational infrastructure.

  • Opportunities to collaborate with academic and external partners.

  • Support for the development of applications for research and innovation funding.

  • Access to relevant mentoring, career-development and pedagogical activities.

  • Opportunities to contribute to the further development of innovation within the department’s research and educational programmes.

title: Teamspective: Account Executive (Denmark or Sweden)
description: **Type:** Full-time, permanent**Location:** Helsinki, Copenhagen, Stockholm**Application deadline:** Tue 1.12.2026Join Teamspective, a fast-growing Finnish AI-native SaaS company transforming how organizations lead their people. We're hiring two Account Executives to drive our expansion into Denmark and Sweden!**Your role with us**Teamspective is on a mission to make great leadership a competitive advantage. Our AI-native platform turns employee insights into practical guidance for leaders routines, helping managers lead better every day. With strong growth, proven customer success across the Nordics, and ambitious international plans, we're now ready to accelerate our expansion into Denmark and Sweden.As our **Account Executive for Denmark**, you'll build on our existing customer relationships and strong references, including **Danfoss**, to expand Teamspective's presence in the Danish market. As our **Account Executive for Sweden**, youll focus on opening new opportunities and growing our customer base in a market where were already working with companies like **Hitta.se**. In either role, you'll take ownership of your market and help shape how Teamspective grows internationally.**Your key responsibilities will include:**- Owning the full sales cycle, from prospecting and pipeline building to closing deals, with a focus on mid-sized and large organizations. - Leading discovery meetings and product demos to uncover customer needs and demonstrate Teamspective's value. - Driving B2B sales processes from initial contact to negotiations, procurement, and closing. - Building trusted relationships with HR leaders and other decision-makers through consultative selling. - Developing your market approach and identifying opportunities to scale Teamspective's presence in your country. You'll work closely with our CRO and CEO, existing sales team, and colleagues in customer success and product development, giving you direct access to commercial leadership and the expertise behind our product.Looking further ahead, as Teamspective's presence in your market grows, you could have the opportunity to step into a Country Manager role and build and lead your own local sales team.**Who we're looking for**You're a commercially driven, hands-on sales professional who enjoys opening doors, building relationships, and turning opportunities into results. You know how to engage HR decision-makers and understand what drives their business. You bring strong Danish or Swedish language skills and an understanding of your respective market. Above all, you thrive on taking ownership and are excited to build and grow a market over the long term.**What we expect from you:**- At least 3 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably SaaS, technology, or HR-related - Experience in solution sales to a clearly defined B2B customer segment, with the ability to understand customer challenges and demonstrate business value - A proven track record in new business acquisition and managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing deals - A proactive, independent approach to sales and the drive to build your own pipeline and develop a market - Excellent Danish skills for the Denmark position, or excellent Swedish skills for the Sweden position, alongside good English skills **What we consider a plus:**- Experience selling HR technology solutions or other B2B solutions to HR decision-makers, with an understanding of their business challenges - An established network of HR leaders and decision-makers in Denmark or Sweden - Previous experience opening new markets or developing sales operations in an international growth company **What we offer you:**- Build your market and shape the go-to-market strategy with real ownership. - Sell an AI-native solution that helps organizations turn better leadership into a competitive advantage. - Work alongside experienced leaders and a tight-knit team that moves fast and has your back. - Drive international growth with a proven product, strong customer references, and room to make your mark. - Grow toward a potential Country Manager role and eventually build and lead your own local team. **Practicalities:**These are full-time, permanent positions in which you will be employed directly by Teamspective. You can be based in Helsinki or your respective target market, Copenhagen or Stockholm, after the initial onboarding period. The preferred starting date is as soon as possible in early 2027.**Onboarding:**The role requires you to spend your first 3–6 months working in Helsinki. During this period, you will work closely with Teamspective's commercial, customer success, and product teams, build a deep understanding of the product, and start developing your market from day one. Teamspective will cover accommodation in Helsinki for candidates relocating temporarily. After onboarding, you can work from Helsinki or your respective target country, with regular visits to Helsinki.**Compensation:**The base salary in this position starts from 4000 €/month, complemented by an uncapped commission. As an indicative estimate, on-target earnings (OTE) could range from 90-110 000 euros annually, depending on sales performance. The commission model also includes incentives for qualified meetings during the probationary period. You'll also join Teamspective's employee stock option program after your probationary period. As you grow into a Sales Manager or Country Manager role, there may be opportunities to negotiate a larger equity stake.**Ready to build success in a new market?**Please submit your CV and brief motivation statement by the latest Tue 1st of December 2026 via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/396854/create/.Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

title: Gårdtrækker, 34 timer / Yard driver, 34 hours per week
description:
Vi søger lige nu en Gårdtrækker til REMA Distribution A/S på Hjulmagervej 12 i Vejle

Som medarbejder hos REMA Distribution bliver du del af en virksomhed, der vil være bedst til at drive dagligvarebutik i Danmark – med fokus på kvalitet til lave priser. Du får en central rolle i denne proces og bliver en del af vores gårdtrækkerteam fuld af dygtige og kompetente kolleger i Vejle.

Om jobbetMed reference til Driftschefen indgår du i vores team af medarbejdere, som arbejder tæt sammen med vores lager og logistikafdeling.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver:

  • Kørsel med Gårdtrækker på terminalområdet

  • Til- og frakobling af trailere

  • Klargøring til læsning og losning

  • Truckkørsel og intern transport

  • Læsning, losning og håndtering af gods

  • Lager- og terminalopgaver efter behov

  • Rengøring af Terberg.

Vores lager sørger for, at traileren er læsset og klar, inden den skal fjernes. Du får et selvstændigt og udfordrende fuldtidsjob med løn iflg. overenskomst, pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring.

Du vil skulle arbejde i et 3-ugers rul. Arbejdstiden er om eftermiddagen og skifter i tidsrummet ml. kl. 10.00 og kl. 23.00. Der må påregnes overarbejde i travle perioder.

Dine faglige kvalifikationer

  • Du har kørekort til C/E, chaufføruddannelsesbevis, førerkort og truckcertifikat

  • Du har erfaring fra en lignende stilling

  • Du taler og skriver dansk og/eller engelsk

Dine personlige kvalifikationer

Du er som person selvstændig, serviceminded og sætter en ære i at gøre tingene ordentligt. Som medarbejder og kollega er du fleksibel på arbejdstiden, mødestabil og imødekommende. Du arbejder effektivt uden at miste fokus på sikkerheden, og du har lyst til at give vores kunder en god oplevelse, hvor end du kommer.

Om REMA 1000

I REMA 1000 er vi mere end 17.500 entusiastiske mennesker med ét fælles mål: Vi vil være bedst til at drive dagligvarebutik i Danmark – med fokus på kvalitet til lave priser. Det absolut vigtigste element i den mission er engagerede og virkelystne mennesker, som elsker at gøre en forskel i deres job.

Vi har i dag flere end 440 butikker, og butikkerne er drevet efter en franchisemodel med selvstændige, lokalkendte købmænd i spidsen for den enkelte butik.

I Baglandet hos REMA 1000 / REMA Distribution er vi mere end 1.300 medarbejdere, som skaber konkurrencekraft, servicerer og leverer varer til REMA 1000 butikkerne og andre kæder indenfor dagligvare- og convenience branchen.

Lyder det som noget for dig?Så send os en ansøgning til Drifschef Brian Schmidt på mail: bsc@rema1000.dk .

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig. 

Vi vurderer ansøgningerne løbende, og jobannoncen vil derfor blive fjernet når passende kandidat er fundet.

title: Mechanical Project Engineer - FEM/FEA
description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.  As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. With us you will contribute to global priorities such as energy efficiency, clean water, and Alfa Laval's net-zero 2030 ambition. Let's shape a better tomorrow together!  We design and supply process solutions within various industries, mainly water treatment. As a Mechanical Engineer and FEM/FEA specialist, you will design solutions in 3D with detailed engineering combined with standard components. Our designs contain pipes, pumps, decanters, evaporators, membranes, heat exchangers etc.  Your work involves verification and optimization of mechanical and process equipment, by identifying critical stress concentrations, deformations, and failure modes etc. In this role, you will perform simulations as well as traditional hand calculations to ensure our products meet functional, safety, and regulatory requirements. During project execution you will be working in global project teams with Project Managers, Process Specialists, Automation, Sourcing, and Workshops.  Key tasks and responsibilities:     Design steel structures, skid solutions and custom designs in Autodesk Inventor     FEM/FEA analysis on mechanical designs using ANSYS/Nastran including: Static structural, Buckling, Hydrostatic and internal  pressure, Vibrations and fatigue, Thermal and Pipe support.     Hand calculations     Prepare clear technical reports and design recommendations     Review boundary conditions and results from simulations made by others     Optimize calculation methods, templates, engineering standards, and best practices     DFM in collaboration with workshop and FAT/SAT     Review 3D designs and 2D drawings     Ensure compliance with Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 and CE marking     Apply relevant standards like ASCE/SEI 7-22 and EN1993-1-1  Planned travels, mostly within Europe, for inspections and commissioning is part of the job - approximately 20 - 25 days per year. You will be part of an innovative mechanical team of ten who are continuously implementing smarter ways of working. You report to Jesper Bergstrøm, a people-oriented leader who is passionate about his team thriving in their roles and look forward to going to work. At Alfa Laval, we embrace a hybrid work model, allowing you to work from home when it aligns with your tasks.   Who are you You are a results-driven, high-energy professional who maintains focus and a positive attitude while pursuing ambitious goals. You take initiative, make calculated decisions with confidence, and consistently turn plans into action. You build strong networks across and beyond the organization, using your relational skills to influence, collaborate, and create impact. Proactive, timely, and quality-minded, you work effectively with others and help drive collective success.  What you know We are looking for you with solid skills and experience in FEM/FEA analysis with skid- and steel structures solutions. The role involves a lot of collaboration and while you can independently, we believe you enjoy collaborating across disciplines and are able to communicate complex technical topics clearly.  Requirements:     Degree in Mechanical Engineering     Deep knowledge in FEM/FEA analysis with skid- and steel structures solutions.     Working proficiency in defining the scope, building an efficient model, performing the analysis, interpreting the results, and delivering clear engineering conclusions within a typical timeframe of 1-2 weeks depending on complexity.     Excellent communication skills in English   For more information, please contact Jesper Bergstrøm, Engineering Manager, Mechanical Engineering & Design, WIFH PM&E +45 4271 8160 Charlotta Lundblad, Talent Acquisition Partner   We are conducting a continuous review of received applications and the ad might be closed before ending date. We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Please send your application no later than November 25, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long! At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in Søborg (Denmark) or have an established presence in the area.  Our commitment to integrity We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioural traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. title: Warehouse Specialist
description:

Talgo is a leading international train manufacturer and maintenance provider with more than 75 years of experience in railway innovation.

Department: Talgo Warranty / Logistics & Warehouse Operations
