title: Scientist / Process Engineer Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
description: Do you have a passion for manufacturing technology and a practical, engineering mindset? Are you motivated by hands-on problem solving and interested in developing and optimizing processes for the next generation of oral medicines? Then this could be the role for you.Pharmaceutical Technology & Development (PT&D) develops drug products and technologies to support new medicines from development through scale-up and transfer to commercial manufacturing. Within PT&D, Global Product Development (GPD) develops oral, inhaled and parenteral drug products, working to turn innovative science into medicines for patients.Continuous Direct Compression (CDC) is a key technology for oral drug development at AstraZeneca, enabling the development of sustainable oral products for commercialization. We are now looking for a Scientist / Process Engineer to join the Process Technology and Engineering team within GPD, based at our Gothenburg site in Sweden. In this role, you will work with CDC technology and contribute to its development and the next generation of oral medicines.AccountabilitiesWe are developing Phase 3 and commercial-ready CDC manufacturing technology and are looking for an engineer or scientist who is eager to further develop their expertise in this area.In this hands-on role, you will operate, troubleshoot and optimize CDC equipment, prepare associated technical documentation, and develop towards becoming an expert in CDC technology and the mechanical operation of the CDC line. You will contribute directly to product delivery and provide key data and insights to our drug development projects.You will bring a passion for manufacturing and process technology, a hands-on approach to problem solving, and the curiosity to find new ways to optimize and maximize the use of the equipment.You will also play an active part in GPD's journey to become an agile, digital-first organization that harnesses data, models and AI to accelerate development, elevate quality and deliver sustainable productivity.You will:    Act as a GPD expert on the CDC process, working with and sharing knowledge across project teams to support delivery of the drug project portfolio.    Assemble, operate, troubleshoot, disassemble, and clean CDC equipment.    Ensure all work is performed safely and in accordance with applicable quality systems and procedures.    Develop and optimize robust manufacturing processes and technologies, using experimental and process data to understand and improve process and equipment performance.    Prepare technical documentation and formal reports in line with current standards and, where appropriate, GLP (Good Laboratory Practice) and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice).    Support the development and implementation of manufacturing processes and technologies for control strategy, scale-up, marketing applications, technology transfer to commercial manufacturing sites, and launch.    Assess and interpret technical and process data and communicate conclusions and recommendations to project teams, within GPD and across other functions.    Work flexibly and prioritize effectively, applying a continuous improvement mindset and contributing to improvement projects.    Continuously develop your technical expertise while sharing knowledge and supporting the development of others.    Contribute to the development, validation, and use of CDC process models and digital twins to support product development and technology transfer.    Generate and structure high-quality CDC process data in line with GPD data standards, supporting FAIR and AI-ready data for reuse in data products and models.    Act as a Digital champion for CDC team by applying a digital-first mindset, including the appropriate use of GenAI and digital tools, to improve efficiency and ways of working.Essential skills & experience    MSc or equivalent in pharmaceutical sciences, chemical engineering or related discipline.    Recent and substantial hands-on experience assembling, operating, troubleshooting and cleaning manufacturing equipment in a laboratory, pilot-scale or manufacturing environment.    Experience working in GLP, GMP or similarly regulated environments, with a strong focus on safety, quality systems, and accurate documentation.    Strong knowledge of formulation and process development for oral solid dosage forms, including how material properties and process parameters affect product quality.    Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to interpret technical and process data, communicate clear conclusions and recommendations to cross-functional project teams, and prioritize flexibly to deliver project objectives.Desirable skills & experience    Experience with continuous manufacturing, ideally Continuous Direct Compression (CDC), including Process Analytical Technology (PAT) and real-time process monitoring and control.    Demonstrated practical experience with engineering tools, data analysis and digital modelling, for example process modelling, statistics, Python or MATLAB, to analyze and understand process performance.    Experience with, or a strong interest in, applying AI, GenAI and data-driven approaches to scientific or engineering work.    Experience of scale-up and technology transfer to commercial manufacturing sites, including contributing to regulatory submissions.    Familiarity with continuous improvement methodologies, such as Lean or Six Sigma. Are you ready to develop your expertise in Continuous Direct Compression and contribute to the future of oral drug development? Apply today and join us in Gothenburg. We welcome your application by 22 November 2026. Please submit your application as soon as possible, as we will review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis throughout the application period.

With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.Job OverviewAssignment DescriptionWe are looking for a Technical Information Specialist to create and maintain diagnostic-related service information for the heavy vehicle industry.You will develop clear, standardized technical content that enables workshops worldwide to troubleshoot, calibrate, maintain, and repair vehicles efficiently. The information must be structured and integrated into the relevant diagnostic tool (SWS).The role involves working with technical documentation, diagnostic systems, and cross-functional teams within the aftermarket and E-mobility Diagnostics area.What You Will Work On    Create and maintain fault code descriptions.    Develop step-by-step diagnostic and calibration guides.    Prepare component information and technical function descriptions.    Create and maintain user interface (UI) texts.    Develop technical illustrations.    Ensure technical information is clear, standardized, and integrated into SWS.    Work with internal tools such as OAS, Catalyst, SWS, Production Tool (PT), and GitLab.    Collaborate with relevant teams using Jira and agile methodologies.What You Bring    At least 2–3 years of experience in a similar technical writing or technical information role.    Relevant education or experience in Technical Communication, Technical Writing, Information Technology, or a related technical field.    Strong written and verbal communication skills in Swedish and English.    Basic technical knowledge and a genuine interest in vehicles.    Experience working with Jira and agile methodologies.    A valid driver's licence.Meritorious    Knowledge of AI applications in technical writing.    UX or front-end development skills.    Experience with OAS, Catalyst, SWS, Production Tool, or GitLab.    Experience in the heavy vehicle industry.    Experience with automotive diagnostics and technical service documentation.

title: Site Manager
description: CMS Construction Management Solutions Oy is looking for an experienced Site Manager for a industrial project in the Gothenburg region, Sweden.As Site Manager, you will be responsible for coordinating and overseeing daily site activities, contractors and multidisciplinary works. The project is approaching the pre-commissioning and commissioning phase, and an important part of the role is to support a controlled transition from construction and mechanical completion towards commissioning.**Your responsibilities include**- managing and coordinating daily construction and site activities - coordinating contractors, technical disciplines and other site stakeholders - monitoring site progress, resources and upcoming activities - ensuring that works are carried out according to project requirements, schedule, quality standards and safety procedures - identifying and resolving constraints, interface issues and other matters affecting site progress - coordinating the transition from construction and mechanical completion towards pre-commissioning and commissioning - supporting system handovers, inspections, testing and commissioning preparations - monitoring safety, quality, schedule and cost performance - reporting site progress and key issues to project management **We are looking for**- relevant technical education - extensive experience in similar Site Manager, Construction Manager or site management roles in industrial projects - strong understanding of construction site operations and multidisciplinary coordination - good understanding of safety, quality and schedule requirements in industrial projects - good IT and reporting skills - good command of English **Applicants must have the right to work in Sweden.****Accommodation and project-related travel can be arranged by CMS as agreed.****Location:** Gothenburg region, Sweden **Start:** December 2026 – January 2027 **Estimated duration:** approximately 6 months

and support a cross-functional development team throughout project planning, execution, follow-up, and delivery.    Facilitate Scrum practices and other agile ways of working while ensuring alignment with project goals, delivery plans, and milestones.    Coordinate team activities and promote effective collaboration across engineering disciplines and stakeholder groups.    Monitor and report the and manage project risks, dependencies, obstacles, and delivery constraints.    Build stakeholder alignment through structured communication, facilitation, and negotiation.    Drive continuous improvement within the team and across the broader product development process.    Support timely decision-making while maintaining focus on project targets and financial performance.Technical Stack & title: Product Owner  Privileged Access Management
description: Privileged access is central to protecting critical systems and information. As Product Owner for Privileged Access Management (PAM), you combine strong product ownership with an understanding of identity and access management to help identify, control, and secure privileged access across Sandvik’s digital environment. The team You join Identity Fabric, a Product Area within Sandvik Cybersecurity and the central area for digital identities and Identity & Access Management. Identity Fabric brings together several teams working across cybersecurity, IAM, IT platforms, governance, and user experience.  The focus is on creating effective and secure ways to manage privileged identities and access across Sandvik. Within this landscape, PAM addresses access with elevated privileges and helps strengthen how privileged accounts and other identities are identified, managed, and secured.  About the job You take ownership of Sandvik’s PAM capability, with responsibility for outcomes, roadmap, and budget. A key part of your assignment is developing the capability from implementation into an operational service and creating clear priorities for continued improvement.   Job responsibilities     Own and prioritize the backlog, translating business and security needs into clear deliverables.     Define the roadmap, service maturity, KPIs and improvement priorities.     Coordinate the onboarding of applications and platforms into PAM.     Drive decisions and collaboration across cybersecurity, IAM, infrastructure, application teams, vendors, service management and the business.     Support an effective approach to identifying and securing privileged access, focusing on reducing risk rather than on individual tools. Location This position is based on-site at the World Trade Center in Stockholm.  Your profile You bring strong product ownership experience from an enterprise IT or security service, combined with a solid understanding of PAM. You know why PAM matters and have enough technical knowledge to turn business and security needs into clear priorities and deliverables. Your background includes     Experience as a Product Owner, Service Owner, Product Manager or in a similar coordinating position, with responsibility for areas such as backlog, prioritization, roadmap and service development.     Good knowledge of IAM and PAM concepts, including privileged and service accounts, credential management, least privilege, access lifecycle, session management and time-bound privileged access.     A basic understanding of Entra ID and hybrid or on-premises environments.     Experience working with external delivery partners or managed-service providers, as well as change management.     Professional English. You’re driven and outgoing, with a collaborative way of working and strong stakeholder management skills. Comfortable working across organizational boundaries, you bring people together, influence decisions, and keep progress moving even when ownership is shared across several teams. Our culture Our role is clear – through every action, every day, we make the shift and advance the world through engineering. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career options.  Are you intrigued? Visit our website, LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further.  Contact information For further information about this position, please contact Peter Ringwall, hiring manager, peter.ringwall@sandvik.com We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts in that matter. Union contacts – Sweden     Johanna Beijer, Unionen, +46 (0)70 616 18 27     Tord Engström, Akademikerföreningen, +46 (0)76 106 62 87     Peter Olsson-Andrée, Ledarna, +46 (0)70 222 48 55  Recruitment Specialist: Lotta Amnebjer Nordqvist How to apply Send your application no later than November 25, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0098862. We aim for an open and fair recruitment process and use different tools to ensure an objective assessment. Later in the process, you may be invited to complete a personality and logic test. To learn more about our recruitment process, please visit our career site or contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com.     Sandvik is a global, industrial technology group providing solutions that enhance productivity, profitability and sustainability for the manufacturing, mining and infrastructure industries. We are at the forefront of digitalization and focus on optimizing our customers’ processes. Our world-leading offering includes equipment, tools, services and digital solutions for machining, mining, rock excavation and rock processing. In 2025 the Group had approximately 42,000 employees and revenues of about SEK 121 billion in more than 150 countries.

You will work closely with engineering, procurement, suppliers, contractors and other project stakeholders to ensure that technical scopes and documentation are properly coordinated.**Your responsibilities include**- Coordinating the preparation of technical tender and procurement documentation - Collecting and coordinating technical input from different engineering disciplines - Supporting the preparation of technical specifications, scope definitions and related documentation - Monitoring technical documents, reviews, approvals and outstanding actions - Coordinating technical interfaces and identifying possible gaps or overlaps between different scopes - Supporting technical clarifications during the tendering process - Supporting technical evaluations and contractor selection from a technical perspective - Following up on technical package progress, open items and key risks - Maintaining relevant technical documentation and reporting **We are looking for**- Relevant technical education in engineering or a related field - Extensive experience from industrial projects in technical coordination, engineering, procurement or project delivery roles - Experience with technical procurement, tender preparation or contractor coordination - Experience working with multidisciplinary technical scopes, such as **mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and piping** - Good understanding of technical specifications, scope definitions and project documentation - Experience coordinating technical interfaces between different disciplines, suppliers and contractors - Good IT and reporting skills - Good command of English **Applicants must have the right to work in Sweden.****Accommodation and project-related travel can be arranged by CMS as agreed.****Location:** Northern Sweden**Start:** November 2026**Estimated duration:** approximately 12 months

title: Research assistant on vegetation-atmosphere interactions
description: Department of Soil and EnvironmentA 2-month research assistant position is available in the Soil and Environmental Physics group at the Department of Soil and Environment, Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU), in Uppsala. We are looking for a researcher with interest in vegetation-atmosphere interactions, in particular using eddy-covariance data. We offer a stimulating research environment with opportunities to collaborate with soil scientists and ecologists, within SLU, in Sweden and internationally).About the positionAs a research assistant in the project, you will be expected to drive independent research, including data collection from online databases and statistical data analyses, writing scientific papers in collaboration with the project group and external collaborators, and presenting research results at seminars and conferences.Your profileWe are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher with excellent skills and experience in collection, harmonization, and statistical analysis of eddy covariance data on carbon fluxes. We are particularly interested in candidates able to link eddy covariance data to remote sensing products.Given the nature of the research project, we expect the selected candidate to be able to interact with soil scientists, ecologists, and biogeochemists. Experience in publishing in highly ranked scientific journals in English is also important.About usThe Department of Soil and Environment is a leading soil research institution, both nationally and internationally. Our research focuses on fundamental soil properties and processes, as well as how soil functions are affected by changes in environmental conditions, including climate change. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decision-making in agriculture, forestry and the urban environment. The working environment at the department is international and we have around 100 employees.Our research is carried out in seven subject groups with a focus on Soil Biology, Soil Nutrient Cycling, Soil Chemistry, Agricultural Water Management, Soil and Environmental Physics, Soil Mechanics and Soil Management, and the Biogeochemistry of Forest Soils. We are responsible for important research infrastructure in the form of soil chemistry and soil physics laboratories, an X-ray scanner, long-term field experiments, a lysimeter facility, and the field research stations at Lanna and Lövsta. The Department participates in approximately 30 courses at undergraduate and advanced level.We are a part of the Soil, Water and Environment Center at SLU (MVM-center), which provides links to research on water systems, recycling and bioenergy. Our work is aligned to national environmental and climate goals as well as to the Sustainable Development Goals. We are situated at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and in Skara. Read more about the department here (https://www.slu.se/en/departments/soil-environment/).Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Location:UppsalaForm of employment:Temporary substitute employment 2 monthsScope:100%Start date:As agreed. Application:Please submit your application before deadline 25 November 2026. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update.You can submit your application by clicking the button below.Union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/ The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

title: Structural Engineer -  Nuclear power industry -20757
description: Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.Job OverviewRole SummaryOur client is seeking an experienced Structural Engineer for an assignment in the nuclear power industry. The role focuses on structural mechanics and advanced structural analysis, covering both static and dynamic behavior. The engineer will assess how metallic and steel structures respond to different loads and loading scenarios, verify compliance with applicable strength requirements, and contribute to the overall assurance of structural integrity.Key Responsibilities    Perform static and dynamic structural analyses of safety-critical constructions.    Evaluate structural responses to different load cases and loading scenarios.    Assess the strength, resistance, and integrity of metallic and steel structures.    Develop and apply analytical methods within structural mechanics and strength engineering.    Verify that designs and structures satisfy relevant strength and structural integrity requirements.    Use finite element analysis tools to model and assess structural behavior.Technical Stack & Requirements    ANSYS Mechanical: Extensive experience performing structural and mechanical simulations.    LS-DYNA: Experience with dynamic analysis and complex loading scenarios.    Finite Element Analysis: Strong practical background in computational structural assessment.    Structural mechanics: Advanced knowledge of strength, load response, and structural integrity.    Materials and structures: Extensive experience analyzing metallic and steel constructions.Qualifications & ExperienceA Master of Science or Bachelor of Science degree in engineering with a relevant technical specialization is required. Previous experience from the nuclear power industry is required.

title: Dutch-Speaking Customer Service Representative

We are looking for someone who combines a genuine passion for service with strong technical aptitude, a solution-oriented mindset and excellent written communication skills in Dutch and English.The RoleYou will support our customers via email, chat and occasional phone support, handling questions about products, orders, deliveries, returns, payments and technical issues throughout the e-commerce journey.Alongside your Customer Service responsibilities, you will support our E-commerce and CRM teams with Dutch-language translation and localization for our website, newsletters and other customer-facing content. Your ability to write clear, natural and engaging Dutch that reflects the STRONGER tone of voice will be an important part of the role.You will also collaborate across teams, identify recurring customer issues, share insights and contribute to improvements in our customer experience and internal processes.Key Responsibilities    Provide professional, personal and solution-oriented customer service via email, chat and phone, primarily for Dutch-speaking customers.    Assist customers with products, orders, deliveries, returns and payments.    Investigate and troubleshoot technical and system-related issues across multiple platforms.    Translate, proofread and localize website content, newsletters and other e-commerce communications into Dutch.    Ensure Dutch copy is accurate, consistent, engaging and aligned with the STRONGER brand voice.    Collaborate with E-commerce, CRM, Operations, Logistics and Tech when needed.    Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve processes and the customer journey.    Work towards Customer Service KPIs and shared team goals.Who We’re Looking ForYou are proactive, structured and solution-oriented, with a genuine interest in providing great customer service. You enjoy taking ownership, working both independently and as part of a team, and switching between customer conversations and written content tasks.You do not need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable learning digital systems, investigating problems and finding practical solutions.Requirements    Fluent Dutch, both written and spoken, with excellent spelling, grammar and the ability to adapt your tone for different audiences.    Strong English skills, both written and spoken.    Previous Customer Service experience, preferably within e-commerce or a digital environment.    Strong technical aptitude and confidence working across multiple digital systems.    Good problem-solving skills, attention to detail and a structured way of working.    Ability to maintain high service quality in a fast-paced environment.    Confidence in writing, editing and proofreading customer-facing content in Dutch.Nice to Have    Experience with Zendesk, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or Centra.    Technical troubleshooting experience within e-commerce.    Experience with automation, AI-supported customer service tools or similar technologies.    Additional languages: Swedish, German and/or French.    Previous experience with translation, localization, newsletters or e-commerce copywriting.How to ApplyPlease send your CV and cover letter to madelene@stronger.se.In your application, highlight any experience with the systems, technical areas, translation or localization tasks, and additional languages listed above, including your level of proficiency.Use Dutch-Speaking Customer Service Representative as the email subject line.Employment: Full-time (100%), fixed-term maternity cover, March 2027 – August 2028, with the possibility of extension.Start date: March 2027Location: StockholmWe look forward to hearing from you!

title: Automation Engineer
description: At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions ofpeople's lives every day. And we need people like you to make it happen.We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.Job SummaryProcessing Liquid Food Solutions is responsible for development and manufacturing of solutions and branded processing units for the processing of liquid foods within Dairy, Beverage, Prepared Food and Plant-Based applications. We work closely with our market operations and customers to understand their true needs to secure that we create and convey our solutions that provide the greatest value for Tetra Pak and its Customers.Processing Liquid Food Solutions has approximately 400 employees in six main sites: Sweden, China, USA, India, Singapore and Mexico.We are looking for an Automation Engineer that will have a key role in our customer order projects. You will be responsible for and manage the automation design and engineering in orders. Beyond technical responsibilities, you will also engage in customer relations and contribute to product development initiatives. Joining a dynamic team of skilled process-, automation-, and mechanical engineers, you will contribute to delivering innovative processing solutions to our diverse range of customers worldwide.The position is permanent, and you will be based in Lund, Sweden. The position will include some travelling.What you will do    Be the expert in automation design and engineering in customer orders throughout the order process and be responsible for control system specification, programming, and function descriptions in orders.    Contribute to product development initiatives.    Provide technical support to our sales organization during the pre-sale stage.    Drive technical discussion together with our project centers to understand and convey the local customer need.    Handle technical issues and documentation.    As your experience grows, be involved and drive troubleshooting and meetings at customer site.We believe you have    Technical education and minimum 3 years of experience in a similar position within the food processing industry.    Experience with PLC and HMI programming as well as theoretical or practical automatic control knowledge. Knowledge of Siemens, Rockwell or other well-known automation systems.    A natural way of utilizing necessary standards, guidelines, tools, and methods when doing automation design.    While not mandatory, experience in order management, customer handling, and project management are considered advantageous.    Fluent in written and spoken English.    It is advantageous if you have been involved in automation control system migration projects i.e., S7 to TIA, SLC500 to RSLogix 5000 or various HMI conversions including Panel View, E-Designer, Quick Designer.We believe that you are a highly service-minded and customer-centric person who enjoys working in a fast-paced, changing environment. Your effective communication skills enable you to interact with people at all levels, and you excel both independently and in collaborative group settings. Demonstrating a strong drive for results, you work in a structured and organized manner, always striving to deliver the best solutions for our customers. We also encourage individuals with an interest and ambition to grow their leadership skills to apply.We Offer You    A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape     A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results    An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion    Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangementsApply NowIf you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/. This job posting expires on 25th November 2026.If you have any questions about your application, please contact Zsofia Tamaska - zsofia.tamaska@tetrapak.com.For trade union information, contact Unionen Lisbeth Larsson at +46 46 36 2320 and Akademikerklubben Lars Haraldsson at +46 46 36 2533A background check may be performed on the final candidate as part of the recruitment process.Diversity, equity, and inclusion is an everyday part of how we work. We give people a place to belong and support to thrive, an environment where everyone can be comfortable being themselves and has equal opportunities togrow and succeed. We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.

disponibilité pour des interventions ponctuelles en soirée, des maintenances planifiées et des piquets. **Résidence en Suisse.** **Notre proposition** * Modern Workplace : dernières technologies et description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Senior Software Engineer Backend (Mandatsaufträge)--- Senior Software Engineer Backend (Mandatsaufträge)===================================================### We invent. Mit Substanz. Gute Software entsteht nicht zufällig. Sie entsteht durch Weitsicht, technisches Können und echte Zusammenarbeit. Seit über 25 Jahren entwickeln wir nachhaltige IT\-Lösungen mit offenen Technologien und einem klaren Anspruch an Qualität. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt unserer Arbeit liegt im Mobilitätsumfeld und im öffentlichen Sektor. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen entwickeln wir Lösungen, die täglich von vielen Menschen genutzt werden und einen gesellschaftlichen Mehrwert stiften. Dabei setzen wir auf langfristige Partnerschaften und begleiten unsere Kund:innen oft über viele Jahre hinweg im Rahmen von Mandaten. So kannst du Lösungen nicht nur mitentwickeln, sondern massgeblich und nachhaltig prägen.  ### You contribute – Das bringst du mit * Java\-Expertise: Du bewegst dich absolut sicher im Java\-Ökosystem und hast über viele Jahre bereits etliche komplexe Backend\-Lösungen mit Boot realisiert.* Architektur\-Mindset: Du durchdringst komplexe Systeme mühelos und bringst ein tiefes Verständnis für moderne Backend\-Architekturen mit.* KI\-Mindset: Du bringst eine natürliche Vertrautheit mit modernen KI\-Tools und Coding\-Assistants mit und bist interessiert an neuen Workflows wie dem Agentic Coding.* Macher:in \& Teamplayer: Du arbeitest gerne eigenverantwortlich, blühst aber erst im interdisziplinären Team so richtig auf.* Nah am Kunden: Freude an der langfristigen Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen in agilen Teams – vorausgesetzt sind dafür sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse. Idealerweise bringst du eine Ausbildung in Informatik (Uni, FH oder HF) mit. Von Vorteil sind Erfahrungen mit Frontend\-Technologien wie Angular oder React sowie Kenntnisse in Quarkus, PostgreSQL, Kafka und containerisierten Umgebungen mit Docker oder Kubernetes. Eine Affinität zur Mobilität rundet dein Profil ab. ### You invent – Das lernst und entwickelst du bei uns * Architektur \& Code: Du treibst die Weiter\- und Neuentwicklung moderner Backend\-Lösungen voran und prägst technische Konzepte sowie Systemarchitekturen aktiv mit.* Qualität aus Überzeugung: Du lebst Clean Code und sicherst die Softwarequalität durch Reviews, automatisiertes Testing und gezielten Einsatz von KI\-Tools zu.* Interdisziplinärer Teamspirit: Du arbeitest eng mit Kolleg:innen in interdisziplinären, agilen Teams zusammen um ganzheitliche Produkte zu schaffen.* Kundennähe: Du berätst unsere Kund:innen auf Augenhöhe bei technischen Fragestellungen und unterstützt sie im Rahmen von Mandaten nachhaltig und langfristig – von der Idee bis zum Support des produktiven Systems.* Wissens\-Hub: Als Senior teilst du dein Wissen im Team und unterstützt jüngere Entwickler:innen in ihrer Entwicklung. ### We care – Das erwartet dich bei uns* Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und echte Mitverantwortung* Langfristige Kundenbeziehungen und Projekte mit Substanz* Flexible Arbeitszeiten und gute Sozialleistungen* Ein unkompliziertes, kollaboratives Umfeld* Arbeitsort vor Ort in Bern, remote work bedingt möglich ### BewerbungWir sind unkompliziert und mögen den direkten Kontakt zu dir. Deshalb akzeptieren wir keine Bewerbungen von Stellenvermittler:innen. Wir freuen uns auf deine Kontaktaufnahme, am liebsten direkt über unsere Website:![Puzzle ITC AG]()* Puzzle ITC AG  Belpstrasse 37  3007 Bern*jid25e2cbfjm jit1146jm jiy26jm

Nous recherchons une personne polyvalente, fiable avec un bon esprit d'équipe et le sens du service aux utilisateurs.* Expérience réussie dans un premier poste similaire et solides connaissances en informatique : environnements Microsoft, systèmes Windows, réseaux, infrastructure et périphériques ;* Esprit pratique, orienté solution, à l’aise avec le câblage et l’installation de matériel, en extérieur et par tous les temps ;* Des notions dans le domaine électrique (courant faible, raccordements, alimentation des équipements) constituent un atout ;* Disponible certains week\-ends en saison ;* Permis de conduire, à l’aise à ski ou en snowboard.### Avantages* Un cadre de travail unique dans les Alpes vaudoises* Une équipe engagée et dynamique* Des projets variés et innovants* Des possibilités de formation continueAinsi que :* Carte remontées mécaniques Suisse (RMS)* Avantages partenaires TVGD* Événements d’entreprise* Facilités de transport### CandidatureNous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre dossier complet d’ici le 30 novembre prochain.Rejoignez un environnement exigeant, concret et passionnant, au cœur de la montagne.![Télé- -Gryon-Diablerets SA]()* Télé\- \-Gryon\-Diablerets SA  Rue Centrale 120  1884 \-sur\-Ollon*jidcda331fjm jit1146jm jiy26jm

title: Process Engineer Sequencing
description: Roche Switzerland bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are based here. For our long\-standing client, Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz, we are looking for a:**Process Engineer Sequencing**Roche Sequencing systems represent a crucial frontier in diagnostics—delivering advanced genomic insights that are critical for personalized healthcare and patient welfare. Within the technology area Sensor \& Cartridge Operations (S\&C), we focus on cutting\-edge Next\-Generation Sequencing platforms. The team proudly works on a highly innovative, revolutionary product currently in its Research Use Only (RUO) phase, which has been developed in the USA and is being manufactured in Rotkreuz (Switzerland). This product leverages breakthrough complementary metal\-oxide\-semiconductor (CMOS) sensor modules and sequencing by expansion (SBX) nanopore technology to fundamentally transform genomics.**Your Responsibilities*** Shopfloor Support \& SME Role: Provide direct, hands\-on technical support for daily production operations. Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support production operators during the exciting ramp\-up phase of our newly established production line. Proactively drive Continuous Improvement initiatives to optimize yield and efficiency.* Document \& Change Management: Create and maintain robust process documentation, change records, and work instructions in line with GxP standards.* Product Care \& NC Management: Take ownership of product care activities within the Squad. This includes handling non\-conformity notifications, leading structured investigations and root\-cause analyses, and coordinating corrective actions in the manufacturing process.* Data\-Driven Process Monitoring: Monitor production data and analyze production and process performance indicators to ensure process stability and high quality.* Global Collaboration \& Coordination: Coordinate and collaborate closely with internal and external partners, including exchange with subject matter experts in Santa Clara, USA.**Must Haves:*** Degree in Natural Sciences or Engineering ( , Biotechnology, Biology, Chemistry, Materials Science, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering) or equivalent apprenticeship and professional experience.* 2–3 years of experience in a highly regulated environment with a strong quality and GxP mindset.* Solid knowledge of non\-conformity management, deviations, change control, and technical documentation.* Hands\-on experience troubleshooting manufacturing processes and supporting operators during production ramp\-ups.* Proactive, independent team player with strong communication skills, eager to take responsibility, learn new manufacturing technologies, and drive continuous process improvements in collaboration with Engineering, Operations, QA, and Logistics.* Fluent English and good German skills (B2\+).**Nice to Haves:*** Experience in Technical Supplier Management, supplier relations, and technical or process change initiatives.* Experience in data\-driven process monitoring, KPI analysis, and experimental design (DoE) using statistical tools.* Strong coaching and communication skills to act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and support shopfloor operators during ramp\-ups.**What we offer:*** The opportunity to work for one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.* A modern campus with extensive green spaces and meeting areas.* A central location with easy access to the motorway and a nearby train station.* A varied range of responsibilities.* The opportunity to work in a dynamic and motivated squad team of 6* Very good compensationPlease send your complete application documents to Mr. Severin Räfle.Chemistry, Pharmaceuticals, Pharmacy, Diagnostics, Zug, Lucerne, Vollzeit, Elektroingenieur, Produktion, Laborj4id10479148jm j4it1146jm j4iy26jm

title: Senior Clinical Scientist
description: Roche Switzerland bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are located here. For our long\-term client, F. Hoffmann\-La Roche AG in Basel, we are looking for a**Senior Clinical Scientist****Background:**In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life\-changing innovation at speed.Neuroscience \& Rare Diseases (NRD), we are committed to realizing the vision of the Roche One Pharma Strategy in Neurology to preserve and restore what makes people who they are. Our research and early development activities center around large and rare indications within four major therapeutic network areas: Dementias, Multiple Sclerosis, Movement Disorders, and Neuromuscular \& Neurodevelopmental Disorders. With strengths across diverse disciplines, Roche is uniquely positioned to lead in transforming science to medicines for patients with disorders of the nervous system.**Tasks \& Responsibilities:*** Your activities will include the development and writing of study documentation including protocols, informed consent forms, clinical study reports, as well as clinical science input for study\-specific operational and regulatory documents.* You will be responsible for ongoing monitoring of clinical activities and study conduct, coordination of data collection, data review, analysis, and interpretation as well as preparation and presentation of results for informed decision\-making.* You will be the main point of contact for data management regarding periodic clinical data review and data cleaning* You will participate in study management, as clinical science representative, to ensure trial deliverables are met according to timelines, budget, quality standards and operational procedures, within a global multidisciplinary cross\-functional Study Management Team (SMT)* You will provide training and science input to operation colleagues and study site staff, as agreed with clinical operations* You will monitor study progress on a regular basis to identify any problems or issues that could affect the results or completion of the study; you will investigate and employ problem\-solving strategies.* You should bring a positive, energetic, responsible, creative, curious and solution\-seeking mindset and proactively contribute to interdisciplinary clinical project teams with integrity, passion and courage.**Must Haves:*** PhD or Masters with extensive work experience as a clinical scientists* 5\+ years the clinical scientist role in different neurological indications, preference for Multiple Sclerosis and Alzheimer’s Disease* You possess strong analytical and quantitative skills, with a proven track record in clinical data review, analysis, and reporting data.* You have a solid understanding of clinical development processes (phase 2\-3\), study design principles, and international clinical research and safety guidelines.* You are a collaborative, solution\-oriented scientist who communicates effectively across teams, values diverse perspectives, and makes sound, independent decisions.* You have excellent written, oral communication, and presentation skills.* Fluency in English**Nice to Have:*** Veeva**What you will be offered:*** An opportunity to work in one of the world's most important pharmaceutical companies* Modern campus with plenty of green spaces and meeting areas* Central location in Basel* Varied job profile* Further training opportunities through temptraining* Working in a dynamic and motivated teamIf you are interested please send your application documents addressed to Ms Marianne Buser.Basel\-Stadt Neuroscience Clinical Trial Management Data Analysis Reporting clinical scientists Clinical Developmentj4id10478384jm j4it1146jm j4iy26jm

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Persischer Spezialitäten Koch 100% (m/w/i)---Persischer Spezialitäten Koch 100% (m/w/i)===========================================nach VereinbarungPersischer Spezialitäten Koch 100% (m/w/i)===========================================nach Vereinbarung  Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873\. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.    Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.    Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.     Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab nach Vereinbarung eine/n:      Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören* das Sicherstellen eines authentischen \& neuzeitlichen Speisenangebotes unter Berücksichtigung der Saisonprodukte des Originallandes sowie das Erstellen der ükarte in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Küchenchef* die Zubereitung der Gerichte sowie der einwandfreie Umgang mit Produkten, Produktion\- und Kochtechniken* die Verantwortung der Einhaltung der Hygienerichtlinien sowie der Arbeitssicherheit* das Kochen in der offenen Showküche vor demSie sind ein ausgebildeter und berufserfahrener Koch mit fundiertem Fachwissen über die persischen Spezialitätenküche sowie umfangreichen Kochtechniken. Sie haben Erfahrung in der internationalen gehobenen Gastronomie und Hotellerie. Deutsch und Englisch beherrschen Sie fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist von Vorteil. Sie zeigen hohe Leistungsbereitschaft, sind leidenschaftlich und arbeiten auch unter Zeit\- und Arbeitsdruck ruhig, exakt und gästeorientiert. Unternehmerisches Handeln und Denken zeichnet Sie aus.  Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV\-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA\-Checks.    Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.    Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: Mit Zugang zur Beekeeper\-Mitarbeiterapp, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Karriereperspektiven schaffen wir den Rahmen für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entfaltung.    Sie erwartet die Chance, Teil eines Weltklasse\-Resorts zu sein, aktiv zum gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen und sich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.    Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitszeugnissen und Foto.    Auszeichnungen:  Swiss Location Awards «Switzerland's Best Meeting Location»  World Spa Awards «Switzerland's Best Hotel Spa 2025»  LHW Membership Awards «Sustainability Leader»  Great Place To Work 2025  The New York Times'«52 Places to Go in 2018»   Travel \+ Leisure«500 List 2021»  Handelszeitung «Bester Arbeitgeber im Hospitality Sektor 2023»  Connoisseur Circle «Best Gourmet Hotel»  MICHELIN Wellness Award «Best Wellness Hotel»  GALA Spa Awards «Best Spa Concept»  MICHELIN Keys «3/3 Keys»    BÜRGENSTOCK HOTELS AG  Lukretia  Human Resources Manager  Bürgenstock 30  6363 Obbürgen  Telefon    ******jid15365bfjm jit1146jm jiy26jm

title: Senior Legal Officer
description: Join MSF OCG as Senior Legal Officer! We are looking for passionate people who are ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission. Find out below the details of the position and the qualifications we are looking for. Inclusion and Diversity at MSF Your qualifications and experience do not exactly match all the requirements? At MSF OCG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff. We strive to create working environments where teams of people with varied backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF’s social mission and improve outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with. We understand that some people may hesitate to apply if they do not meet all the requirements of the position. Research shows that this is particularly true for women. If you believe your profile is a good fit for this position, we encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet all the qualifications listed. We welcome applications from people of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, origins, religions, beliefs, disabilities and any other diversity characteristics. MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation or abuse, or any form of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will be subject to reference checks. Context & Mission  Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent international medical humanitarian organisation that delivers care to people in need, to people affected by natural or man-made disasters and to victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and irrespective of race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter). The MSF movement is organised around five operational centres, supported by 24 sections and offices around the world. The Operational Centre Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centres. The Senior Legal Officer is part of the Public Fundraising unit, one of the four units of the Fundraising Division within the Communication and Fundraising Department of MSF Switzerland. Reporting to the Legacies Coordinator, they handle the administrative and legal management of legacy and inheritance files, provide legal expertise and help optimise the follow-up of these files, in close collaboration with the Legacies Officers. Main responsibilities  Manage and follow up the administrative and legal aspects of legacy and inheritance files, in French and German, in collaboration with the Legacies Coordinator and in tandem with the Legacies Officer. Contribute to optimising the management of donations, legacies and inheritances, ensuring that all legacies and inheritances intended for MSF Switzerland are actually received and processed optimally and securely. Apply the processes and procedures relating to estates, in particular regarding the acceptance of inheritances and court decisions, while protecting the interests and reputation of MSF Switzerland. Act as legal point of reference for complex files, provide expertise and advice to the team and take responsibility for the quality of file processing, including in the event of errors. Support the Legacies Coordinator with some of their tasks and work with the various external partners, in particular notaries, lawyers, executors and public authorities. Develop, maintain and strengthen relationships with current and potential testators in French- and German-speaking Switzerland, in particular through first contacts, visits, phone calls and events, ensuring regular follow-up with this target audience. Enter and update information in the database, in particular for new estate files, people interested in legacies and inheritances, and ongoing files. Handle the financial follow-up of files in collaboration with the Legacies Coordinator and the MSF Switzerland finance department, in particular in the context of estate administration and the preparation of annual provisions for the files under their responsibility. Profile Education University degree or equivalent training in law, or very good knowledge of inheritance law. Experience Previous experience in a similar role. Previous experience with MSF or another NGO or international organisation is an asset. Technical skills Strong attention to detail. Excellent IT skills, including internet research and office software. Knowledge of the Swiss legal and political system, in particular inheritance law. Analytical skills and comfortable working with figures. Ability to express oneself and argue with ease, both orally and in writing. Languages Bilingual French-German (mandatory). Fluent written and spoken English.  Knowledge of Italian is an asset. Personal qualities Ability to meet deadlines. Very good stress resistance. Independent, enthusiastic, dedicated and motivated, solution-oriented and able to integrate easily into a team. Ability to adapt to varied and unforeseen situations with flexibility and agility. Chauffeur VTC
=============

**Drive Wave recrute des chauffeurs VTC pour les cantons de Canton de Vaud, Zurich et l’ensemble de la Suisse alémanique.**

 

Nous offrons des conditions avantageuses, une grande flexibilité, et la possibilité de gérer librement votre planning selon vos disponibilités.

 

### Vos missions

 

* Transporter les passagers dans le respect des règles de sécurité et des normes professionnelles.
* Assurer un service fiable, discret et ponctuel.
* Adapter votre activité à la demande tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité.


 

### Profil recherché

 

* Permis professionnel B121 (ou équivalent européen D ou D1\)
* Excellente présentation, sérieux et sens du service client.
* Flexibilité horaire (jour/nuit/week\-end).


 

### Nous offrons

 

* Conditions de travail attractives et stables.
* Liberté de gestion du planning.
* Environnement professionnel et encadré.


 

### Candidature

 

Seuls les candidats remplissant toutes les conditions mentionnées seront contactés pour un entretien futur.  
Merci d’envoyer votre CV et vos coordonnées complètes.

 

🇬🇧 English version
------------------------

 

**Drive Wave is hiring VTC drivers in the cantons of Vaud, Zurich and across the German\-speaking Switzerland.**

 

We offer attractive conditions, great flexibility, and the ability to manage your schedule freely according to your availability.

 

### Your Responsibilities

 

* Transport passengers while adhering to safety regulations and professional standards.
* Provide reliable, discreet, and punctual service.
* Adjust your activity to meet demand while maintaining a high level of quality.


 

### Profile Sought

 

* Professional driving license B121 (or equivalent European D or D1 license).
* Excellent appearance, professionalism, and customer service skills.
* Flexible schedule (day/night/weekend).


 

### We Offer

 

* Attractive and stable working conditions.
* Freedom to manage your own schedule.
* A professional and well\-structured work environment.


 

### Application

 

Only candidates meeting all the listed requirements will be contacted for a future interview.  
Please send your CV and full contact details.

 

🇩🇪 VERSION ALLEMANDE  

Drive Wave sucht VTC\-Fahrer (m/w/d)  

Drive Wave sucht zuverlässige und motivierte Fahrer für die Kantone Waadt und Zürich sowie für die gesamte Deutschschweiz.  

Wir bieten attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen, hohe Flexibilität und die Möglichkeit, Ihren Arbeitsplan ganz nach Ihren persönlichen Verfügbarkeiten selbst zu gestalten.  

Ihre Aufgaben  
Fahrgäste unter Einhaltung aller Sicherheitsvorschriften und professionellen Standards befördern.  
Einen zuverlässigen, diskreten und pünktlichen Service gewährleisten.  
Die Tätigkeit flexibel an die Nachfrage anpassen und dabei eine hohe Servicequalität sicherstellen.  
Ihr Profil  
Beruflicher Führerausweis B121 oder gleichwertiger europäischer Führerausweis D oder D1\.  
Gepflegtes Erscheinungsbild, Zuverlässigkeit und ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung.  
Zeitliche Flexibilität (Tag, Nacht und Wochenende).  
Wir bieten  
Attraktive und stabile Arbeitsbedingungen.  
Flexible und selbstständige Gestaltung Ihres Arbeitsplans.  
Ein professionelles und gut organisiertes Arbeitsumfeld.  
Bewerbung  

Nur Bewerberinnen und Bewerber, die alle genannten Anforderungen erfüllen, werden für ein persönliches Vorstellungsgespräch kontaktiert.  

Bitte senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf sowie Ihre vollständigen Kontaktdaten.

\*\*Required profile\*\* \* University degree in communications, journalism, marketing, partnerships, sport management or another relevant field. \* Relevant professional experience in communications, title: Senior Legal Officer
description: Join MSF OCG as Senior Legal Officer! We are looking for passionate people who are ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission. Find out below the details of the position and the qualifications we are looking for. Inclusion and Diversity at MSF Your qualifications and experience do not exactly match all the requirements? At MSF OCG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff. We strive to create working environments where teams of people with varied backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF’s social mission and improve outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with. We understand that some people may hesitate to apply if they do not meet all the requirements of the position. Research shows that this is particularly true for women. If you believe your profile is a good fit for this position, we encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet all the qualifications listed. We welcome applications from people of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, origins, religions, beliefs, disabilities and any other diversity characteristics. MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation or abuse, or any form of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will be subject to reference checks. Context & Mission  Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent international medical humanitarian organisation that delivers care to people in need, to people affected by natural or man-made disasters and to victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and irrespective of race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter). The MSF movement is organised around five operational centres, supported by 24 sections and offices around the world. The Operational Centre Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centres. The Senior Legal Officer is part of the Public Fundraising unit, one of the four units of the Fundraising Division within the Communication and Fundraising Department of MSF Switzerland. Reporting to the Legacies Coordinator, they handle the administrative and legal management of legacy and inheritance files, provide legal expertise and help optimise the follow-up of these files, in close collaboration with the Legacies Officers. Main responsibilities  Manage and follow up the administrative and legal aspects of legacy and inheritance files, in French and German, in collaboration with the Legacies Coordinator and in tandem with the Legacies Officer. Contribute to optimising the management of donations, legacies and inheritances, ensuring that all legacies and inheritances intended for MSF Switzerland are actually received and processed optimally and securely. Apply the processes and procedures relating to estates, in particular regarding the acceptance of inheritances and court decisions, while protecting the interests and reputation of MSF Switzerland. Act as legal point of reference for complex files, provide expertise and advice to the team and take responsibility for the quality of file processing, including in the event of errors. Support the Legacies Coordinator with some of their tasks and work with the various external partners, in particular notaries, lawyers, executors and public authorities. Develop, maintain and strengthen relationships with current and potential testators in French- and German-speaking Switzerland, in particular through first contacts, visits, phone calls and events, ensuring regular follow-up with this target audience. Enter and update information in the database, in particular for new estate files, people interested in legacies and inheritances, and ongoing files. Handle the financial follow-up of files in collaboration with the Legacies Coordinator and the MSF Switzerland finance department, in particular in the context of estate administration and the preparation of annual provisions for the files under their responsibility. Profile Education University degree or equivalent training in law, or very good knowledge of inheritance law. Experience Previous experience in a similar role. Previous experience with MSF or another NGO or international organisation is an asset. Technical skills Strong attention to detail. Excellent IT skills, including internet research and office software. Knowledge of the Swiss legal and political system, in particular inheritance law. Analytical skills and comfortable working with figures. Ability to express oneself and argue with ease, both orally and in writing. Languages Bilingual French-German (mandatory). Fluent written and spoken English.  Knowledge of Italian is an asset. Personal qualities Ability to meet deadlines. Very good stress resistance. Independent, enthusiastic, dedicated and motivated, solution-oriented and able to integrate easily into a team. Ability to adapt to varied and unforeseen situations with flexibility and agility. Ability to manage one’s own work without continuous supervision. Proactive, able to take initiative and put forward new proposals to solve identified problems or improve a situation. Flexibility and ability to work in a multicultural environment. Interest in, understanding of and commitment to humanitarian principles and MSF’s values. Ability to identify urgencies and priorities. Ability to meet deadlines. Flexibility and ability to work in a multicultural environment. Interest in, understanding of and commitment to humanitarian principles and MSF’s values. Working conditions Part-time position (90%): 36 hours per week Permanent contract Place of work: Zurich Ideal start date: March 2027. Gross annual salary (at 100%): CHF 94,440 to CHF 108,348 (depending on equivalent experience and the internal salary scale). Paid holidays: 25 days per year, pro rata temporis, plus Swiss public holidays falling within the contract period. Pension fund: contributions to the pension fund (2nd pillar, LPP/BVG) covered 3/4 by MSF and 1/4 by the employee. Relocation support when moving to Switzerland from another country. How to apply Candidates are invited to submit their application exclusively via our recruitment platform, in line with the following requirements. CV (maximum 2 pages) Cover letter (maximum 1 page) Documents must be written in French or English. The application deadline is 22 November 2026. Please note that we reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if we receive a sufficient number of qualified applications. Applications will be treated confidentially. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We do not wish to use the services of recruitment or placement agencies

title: Senior Product / System Quality & Verification Engineer
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Senior Product / System Quality &amp; Verification Engineer--- Senior Product / System Quality \& Verification Engineer========================================================We are looking for a Senior Product / System Quality \& Verification Engineer to help establish and drive product quality from our first rideable prototypes through development and toward production.This is a hands\-on, cross\-functional individual contributor role at the intersection of product quality, systems integration, verification and reliability.You will work across mechanical, electrical, embedded software, connectivity and system interfaces. You are not expected to be the deepest technical expert in every domain—that responsibility remains with the respective Engineering teams. Instead, you will provide the independent quality perspective that connects these domains and ensures that the complete product is adequately verified, integrated, and ready for release.You will work closely with Mechanical Engineering, System Engineering, Embedded Software / Electronics, Product Management, suppliers and eventually Manufacturing and Service teams.**Key responsibilities**Plan, coordinate, and review verification and validation activities for components, subsystems, and complete e\-bike systems.Define and govern Minimum Test Requirements (MTRs) together with Engineering and suppliers, including appropriate test methods, conditions, sample sizes, and acceptance criteria.Review Supplier validation plans and test evidence, and challenge whether the proposed verification provides sufficient evidence that product requirements are met.Drive and coordinate system integration and end\-to\-end testing to ensure hardware, software, connectivity, and mobile app functions work reliably together.Own and maintain the FRACAS process, leading investigations into complex mechanical, electrical, software, and system\-level issues through root\-cause analysis, corrective actions, verification, and continuous learning.Define and coordinate reliability, durability, environmental, and field\-testing programs to identify risks and improve product robustness before launch.Coordinate homologation and certification testing, and release readiness reviews, ensuring compliance requirements are met and product quality is maintained throughout development.**What success looks like**Success in this role means that, as we move from prototypes toward production, we can confidently answer key questions about product readiness: What are the critical requirements? How are they being verified? Are the tests sufficiently rigorous? What issues have been found, and have the fixes been proven effective?You will ensure that verification activities, test results, product configurations, and compliance evidence are well structured, traceable, and visible, enabling informed decisions on product readiness, certification status, and release milestones.Success also means establishing a robust FRACAS and problem\-solving culture where issues are identified early, investigated systematically, resolved through verified corrective actions, and used to drive continuous improvement across products and processes.Ultimately, you will help build confidence that the complete e\-bike and it’s system is reliable, compliant, and ready for launch, not just at the component level but as an integrated product.Engineering teams will see Quality as a trusted partner that helps identify risks early, challenge assumptions constructively, and support successful product releases.**What you bring**5\+ years of experience in product quality, verification \& validation, reliability engineering, systems engineering, or a related discipline.Experience with complex mechatronic products such as e\-bikes, automotive systems, motorcycles, robotics, or consumer electronics.Strong understanding of verification, validation, reliability engineering, and structured problem\-solving methodologies such as FRACAS, 8D, or equivalent.A systems\-thinking mindset with the ability to work across mechanical, electrical, software, and connectivity domains, and understand how they interact in a complete product.Experience coordinating suppliers, validation activities, and complex system integration across multiple engineering disciplines.Ability to review and challenge test plans, Minimum Test Requirements, validation strategies, and technical evidence without needing to be the deepest subject matter expert in every domain.Comfortable working hands\-on with prototypes, test equipment, diagnostic tools, test data, and failure investigations.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Engineering, Product, Manufacturing, suppliers, and external test partners.Fluent English; or Swiss an advantage given the Switzerland base.![Viiala SA]()* Viiala SA  Route de Crassier 7  1262 Eysins*jid0d25577jm jit1146jm jiy26jm
